songs.title: Modeh Ani
songs.lyrics:
מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ, מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם
שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ
מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי
רִבּוֹן כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְאַדוֹן כָּל הַנְּשָׁמוֹת
וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ
זֶה כְּלַל גָּדוֹל בַּתּוֹרָה
זֶה כְּלַל גָּדוֹל בַּאֱמוּנָה

אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ יְצַרְתָּהּ וְנָפַחְתָּהּ
אַתָּה מְשַׁמְּרָהּ בְּקִרְבִּי
וְאַתָּה עָתִיד לִטְּלָהּ מִמֶּנִּי וּלְהַחֲזִירָהּ בִּי לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא

(modeh ani l'fanecha melech (chai)(2x) v'kayam
shehechezarta bi nishmati b'chemlah rabah emunatecha)(2x)
(modeh ani l'fanecha adonai elohai veilohei avotai
ribon kol hama'asim v'adon kol han'shamot)(2x)
(v'ahavta l'rei'acha kamocha)(3x)
zeh k'lal gadol batorah
(v'ahavta l'rei'acha kamocha)(3x)
zeh k'lal gadol ba'emunah
(atah b'ratah y'tzartah v'nafachtah
atah (m'shamrah)(2x) b'kirbi
v'atah atid lit'lah mimeni ul'hachzirah bi le'atid lavo)(2x)

I give thanks to You living and everlasting ruler for You have restored my soul with mercy.
Great is Your faithfulness.
So long as the soul is within me I give thanks to You, my God, and God of my ancestors, Lord of all creatures, Master of all souls.
You shall love your neighbor as yourself – that verse represents the central tenet of the Torah & faith.
You created it, formed it, breathed it into me. You preserve it within me. You will eventually take it from me, and restore it in me in the time to come.

songs.title: I am grateful
songs.lyrics:
CHORUS:
I am grateful, grateful
Yeah I am grateful, grateful
I am grateful, grateful
Yeah I am grateful, grateful

I am grateful for the trees and the birds and the wind
I am grateful for the precious day about to begin.
I am grateful for my health and for the source of my song
I am grateful, I feel like I belong

CHORUS

I am grateful for the stillness of the sweet morning sun
I am grateful for my loved ones and for my tradition
I am grateful for the sacred breath that keeps me alive
I am grateful… let me tell you why!

מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ, רוּחַ חַי וְקַיָּם
שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ

modeh ani l'fanecha, ruach chai v'kayam
shehechezarta bi nishmati, b'chemla raba emunatecha

I give thanks to You living and everlasting ruler for You have restored my soul with mercy.

So if you're feeling lonely and no joy can be found,
I've got one thing that might help you start to turn it around
Please accept my generous offer, this is no platitude,
Go on and sing yourself some verses of your own gratitude!

CHORUS

songs.title: Elohai n'shama
songs.lyrics:
אֱלהַי נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא

elohai n'shama sh'natata bi t'hora hi

My God, the soul you gave in me is pure.

songs.title: Ilu finu
songs.lyrics:
אִלּוּ פִינוּ מָלֵא שִׁירָה כַּיָּם

(ilu-lu-lu)(4x)
ilu finu maleh-leh shira kayam
oh ilu oh finu maleh-leh shira kayam

If our mouths were as full of song as the sea…

songs.title: Nishmat kol chai
songs.lyrics:
נִשְׁמַת כָּל חַי, תְּבָרֵךְ אֶת שִׁמְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ
כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה יְיָ מִי כָמוֹךָ

(nishmat kol chai, t'vareich et shimcha
adonai eloheinu)(2x)
(kol atzmotai tomarna adonai mi chamocha)(2x)

The breath of all life praises Your name.
All the bones in my body exclaim 'Who is like you?'

songs.title: Tzamah nafshi
songs.lyrics:
כְּאַיָּל תַּעֲרֹג עַל־אֲפִיקֵי־מָיִם
כֵּן נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרֹג אֵלֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים
צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹהִים לְאֵל חָי

(k'ayal ta’arog al afikei mayim
kein nafshi ta'arog eilecha elohim)(2x)
(tzamah nafshi leilohim (l'eil chai)(2x)
tzamah nafshi)(2x) tzamah nafshi

Like a deer longs for streams of water
so my soul longs for you, divine one
my soul is thirsty for the holy one, the living God

songs.title: Hal'luyah
songs.lyrics:
הַלְלוּ־יָהּ

הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְיָ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם הַלְלוּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִים
הַלְלוּהוּ כׇל־מַלְאָכָיו הַלְלוּהוּ כׇּל־צְבָאָו
הַלְלוּהוּ שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ הַלְלוּהוּ כׇּל־כּוֹכְבֵי אוֹר
הַלְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר  מֵעַל הַשָּׁמָיִם
יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְיָ כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָאוּ
וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם חׇק־נָתַן וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר

(hal'luyah)(4x)
hal'lu et adonai min hashamayim, hal'luhu bam'romim
hal'luhu kol mal'achav, hal'luhu kol tz'va'av
hal'luhu shemesh v'yare'ach, hal'luhu kol kochvei or
hal'luhu sh'mei hashamayim v'hamayim asher mei'al hashamayim
(y'hal'lu et sheim adonai, ki hu tzivah v'nivra'u
vaya'amideim la'ad l'olam, chok natan v'lo ya'avor)(2x)

Hallelujah. Praise God from the heavens; give praise on high. Give praise, all you angels, give praise, all divine hosts. Give praise, sun and moon, give praise, all bright stars. Give praise, highest heavens, and you waters that are above the heavens. Let them praise the name of God who commanded that they be created, and who made them endure forever, establishing an order that shall never change.

songs.title: Praise Eilah
songs.lyrics:
(hallelu (eilah)(2x))(4x)

hallelu eilah b'kodsha – halleluyah
halleluha birki'a uzah – halleluyah
halleluha bigvuroteha – halleluyah
halleluha k'rov gud'la – halleluyah
(halleluyah)(4x)

halleluha b'teika shofar – halleluyah
halleluha b'neivel v'chinor – halleluyah
halleluha b'tof umachol – halleluyah
halleluha b'minim v'ugav – halleluyah
(halleluyah)(4x)

halleluha b'tziltz'lei shama – halleluyah
halleluha b'tziltz'lei t'ru'ah – halleluyah
kol han'shamah t'hallel yah – halleluyah
kol han'shamah t'hallel yah – halleluyah
(halleluyah)(4x)

Praise Eilah in Her shrine – halleluyah
Praise Her strength from sea to sky – halleluyah
Praise Her for Her mighty works – halleluyah
Praise the One so generous! – halleluyah
(halleluyah)(4x)

Praise Her with the horn and choir – halleluyah
Praise Her with the harp and lyre – halleluyah
Praise Her with the drum and flute – halleluyah
Praise Her with guitar and lute – halleluyah
(halleluyah)(4x)

Praise Her playing cymbals sounding – halleluyah
Praise Her playing cymbals crashing – halleluyah
May all who breathe keep praising Yah – halleluyah
May all who breathe keep praising Yah – halleluyah
(halleluyah)(4x)

songs.title: Hamei'irah
songs.lyrics:
הַמֵּאִירָה לָאָֽרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים
וּבְטּוּבָה מְחַדֶּשֶׁת בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד
וּבְטּוּבָה מְחַדֶּשֶׁת מַעֲשֶׂה בְּרֵאשִׁית

((hum ha-ha, a-ha-a, ha-a-ha-a)(3x) hum)(4x)
(hamei'irah)(3x) la'aretz
v'ladarim aleha b'rachamim
(hamei'irah)(3x) la'aretz
(v'ladarim aleha)(7x) b'rachamim
uv'tuvah m'chadeshet b'chol yom tamid
uv'tuvah m'chadeshet ma'aseh b'reishit

Each day you bring light to the world and its inhabitants.
Each day you create the world all over again.
Each day you demonstrate your goodness.

songs.title: May we bless
songs.lyrics:
בִּרְכַּת הַנֶּפֶשׁ, בִּרְכַּת הַגּוּף
רְפוּאַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ, רְפוּאַת הַגּוּף
תְּשׁוּבַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ, תְּשׁוּבַת הַגּוּף
אַהֲבַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ, אַהֲבַת הַגּוּף

((birkat)/(r'fuat)/(t'shuvat)/(ahavat)(2x) hanefesh,
(birkat)/(r'fuat)/(t'shuvat)/(ahavat) haguf)(2x)

(Blessing/healing/returning/love) of the soul and body

May we bless and be blessed
May we heal and be healed
May we forgive and be forgiven
May we love and be loved

songs.title: Ashrei
songs.lyrics:
אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ, עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה

(ashrei yoshvei)(2x) veitecha
ashrei yoshvei veitecha od y'hal'lucha selah

Happy are those who dwell in Your house;
they forever praise You.

I sing for you
I sing for what is holy and is true
I sing for all creation
For life and liberation
Everyday anew

songs.title: Hashkiveinu
songs.lyrics:
הַשְׁכִּיבֵֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם
וְהַעֲמִידֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְחַיִּים
וּפְרֹשׂ עָלֵֽנוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ

hashkiveinu adonai eloheinu (l'shalom)(2x)
v'ha'amideinu malkeinu l'chayim
(ufros aleinu sukat sh'lomecha)(2x) amen

Grant, oh God, that we lie down in peace, and raise us up, oh Guardian to life renewed. Spread over us the shelter of your peace.

Shelter us beneath your wings, oh Adonai.
Guard us from all harmful things, oh Adonai.
Keep us safe throughout the night,
Till we wake with morning's light.
Teach us, God, wrong from right, (Amen)(2x).

songs.title: Roll into dark
songs.lyrics:
(Roll into dark, roll into light
Night becomes day, day turns to night)(2x)

בּוֹרֵא יוֹם וָלָיְלָה גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי חשֶׁךְ וְחשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי אוֹר

borei yom valailah
(golel or mip'nei choshech)(2x) v'choshech mip'nei or

God creates day and night, rolling the light away from the darkness and the darkness away from the light.

songs.title: B'sheim Adonai
songs.lyrics:
בְּשֵׁם יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
מִימִינִי מִיכָאֵל, וּמִשְּׂמֹאלִי גַּבְרִיאֵל
וּמִלְּפָנַי אוּרִיאֵל, וּמֵאֲחוֹרַי רְפָאֵל
וְעַל רֹאשִׁי שְׁכִינַת אֵל

b'sheim adonai elohei yisra'eil
mimini micha'eil umismoli gavri'eil
umilfanai uri'eil umei'achorai r'fa'eil
(v'al roshi)(2x) sh'chinat el

In the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, may Michael be at my right hand; Gabriel at my left; before me, Uriel; behind me, Raphael; and above my head the divine presence of God.

((I am)/(You are)/(We are) surrounded by angels of peace
(I am)/(You are)/(We are) protected
(I am)/(You are)/(We are) safe at ease)(3x)

With loving-kindness, to the right
And to the left, a great shield of might
and before my eyes, a guiding light
and the flow of healing, from behind

And up above the holy one
Holds me in her presence
And down below the earth turns slow
Rocking me like a cradle

songs.title: One and Only
songs.lyrics:
If your (God)/(love)/(heart) is my (God)/(love)/(heart), and my (God)/(love)/(heart) is everything,
aren't we all, aren't we all, part of one (God)/(love)/(heart)?
So, let your (God)/(love)/(heart) be my (God)/(love)/(heart) and our (God)/(love)/(heart) be everything.
Oh, we'll all know we're all part of one (God)/(love)/(heart).

So, open up your heart, to all the lost and lonely.
Let no one be alone tonight, before our One and Only.

songs.title: Peace like a river
songs.lyrics:
(I've got peace like a river)(3x) in my soul
And (it flows like a river)(3x) in my soul

(I've got joy like a fountain)(3x) in my soul
And (it flows like a fountain)(3x) in my soul

(I've got love like the ocean)(3x) in my soul
And (it flows like the ocean)(3x) in my soul

שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חֵן וָחֶֽסֶד וְרַֽחֲמִים

(sim shalom (tovah)(2x) uv'rachah
chein vachesed v'rachamim)(2x)

Grant peace, goodness and blessing, grace, kindness, and mercy.

songs.title: Tigdal
songs.lyrics:
תִּגְדַּל שְׁכִינַת עוֹלָם וּנְשַׁבְּחָהּ,
בַּכֹּל וְאֵין מָקוֹם פָּנוּי מִשְּׁכִינָתָהּ.

tigdal sh'chinat olam, un'shab'chah
bakol v'ein makom, panu mishchinatah

May the cosmic presence, Shekhinah, be esteemed, we shall give Her praise. Contained in all, there is no place apart from Her.

אַחַת וְכָל יָחִיד כָּלוּל בְּיִחוּדָהּ,
נֶעְלָמָה וְאֵין קָצֶה לְאַחְדוּתָהּ.

achat v'chol yachid, kalul b'yichudah
ne'lamah v'ein, katzeh l'achdutah

Each and everyone of us is part of the unique.
Invisible, Her unity is boundless.

לֹא גּוּף וְלֹא פָּנִים לְדַמּוֹתָהּ,
וְעֵרֵֶך מֵעַל כֹּל לִקְדֻשָּׁתָהּ.

lo guf v'lo panim, l'damotah
v'eirech mei'al, kol likdushatah

No body, nor face, to which She is alike.
Her holiness has value that’s supreme.

קְדוּמָה לְכָל אֲשֶׁר בִּיצִירָתָהּ,
רֵאשִׁית וְאֵין תְּחִלָּה לְרֵאשִׁיתָהּ.

k'dumah l'chol asher, bitziratah
reishit v'ein t'chilah, l'reishitah

Preceding all within Her own creation,
the very first, without beginning.

עוֹלָם וַאֲשֶׁר בּוֹ בָּבַת עֵינָהּ,
אוֹרָהּ מֵאִיר גְּדֻלָּתָהּ וּמַלְכוּתָהּ.

olam va'asher bo, bavat einah
orah mei'ir g'dulatah, u'malchutah

The contents of the world in the pupil of Her eye,
Her light shining on that greatness and majesty.

שְׁפִיעַת נְבוּאָתָהּ הֶעֱנִיקָה,
לְכָל אֲשֶׁר הֵם סְגֻלָּתָהּ וְתִפְאַרְתָּהּ.

sh'fi'at n'vu'atah, he'enikah
l'chol asher heim, s'gulatah v'tif'artah

She provided prophecy to flow
to those who are Her splendor and Her glory.

רוֹעֶה אֲשֶׁר סִבְלוֹת אֶחָיו רָאָה,
הִבִּיט בְּאַסְפַּקְלְַריָה מְאִירָה.

ro'eh asher sivlot, echav ra'ah
hibit b'aspaklar'yah, m'irah

The shepherd, who knew his people’s pain
saw the light through a radiant prism.

תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת נָתְנָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמָּהּ,
נוֹבַעַת הִיא לְכָל אֲשֶׁר בְּעוֹלָמָהּ.

torat emet natnah, l'yisra'eil amah
nova'at hi l'chol, asher b'olamah

She gave Her people Israel a Torah of truth,
it streams to all, throughout the world.

לֹא נַחְלִיפָהּ וְלֹא נָמִיר דַּרְכָּהּ,
וּנְבַקֵּשׁ פָּנֶיהָ וְקִרְבָתָהּ.

lo nachlifah v'lo namir, darkah
un'vakeis paneha, v'kirvatah

We will not find another, nor replace Her path,
but only seek Her countenance and closeness

צוֹפָה וּמְבִינָה כָּל סֵתֶר וּסְתִירָה,
וּמְלַוָּה מִקֶּדֶם בְּאַהֲבָתָהּ.

tzofah umvinah, kol seiter ustirah
um'lavah mikedem, b'ahavatah

Discerning the hidden and the paradoxical,
Her love has attended us forever

לְכָל אִשָּׁה וָאִישׁ גּוֹמֶלֶת בְּחַסְדָּהּ,
וּבְטוּבָהּ צִוְּתָה לָנוּ ”וּבָחַרְתָּ.“

l'chol ishah va'ish gomelet, b'chasdah
uvtuvah tzivtah lanu, uvacharta

Touching each woman and man with kindness,
Her good will commands us to “choose life.”

עוֹד לֹא אָבְדָה תִּקְוָה לַגְּאֻלָּה,
לִפְדוּת כָּל הַמְּחַכִּים לִישׁוּעָתָהּ.

od lo avdah tikvah, lag'ulah
lifdut kol hamchakim, lishu'atah

The hope has not been lost for redemption,
to rescue all who long for Her salvation.

נִשְׁמַת כָּל חַי בְּחֶסֶד בִּרְכָתָהּ,
וּנְבָרֵךְ עֲדֵי עַד שְׁמָהּ וּתְהִלָּתָהּ.

nishmat kol chai, b’chesed birchatah
un'vareich adei ad, sh'mah ut'hilatah

She blessed all souls alive with compassion.
We will bless Her name, devoted forever.

songs.title: V'achalta
songs.lyrics:
וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ

v'achalta, v'savata, u'veirachta

Eat, be satisfied, and bless

We ate when we were hungry,
and now we're satisfied.
We thank the source of blessing
for all that God provides.

וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ

Hunger is a yearning
in body and in soul.
Earth, air, fire, water,
and spirit make us whole.

וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ

Giving and receiving,
we open up our hands.
From seedtime through the harvest,
we're partners with the land.

וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ

We all share a vision
of wholeness and release,
where every child is nourished
and we all live in peace.

וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ

songs.title: Higaleh na
songs.lyrics:
הִגָּלֶה נָא וּפְרוֹשׂ חֲבִיבִי עָלַי אֶת סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ

hi(galeh)(3x) na (ufros)(2x) chavivi alai
et (sukat)(2x) shlomecha

Please reveal yourself and spread over me, my beloved,
a shelter of your tranquility.

songs.title: Shirat nafshi
songs.lyrics:
הָדוּר נָאֶה זִיו הָעוֹלָם, נַפְשִׁי חוֹלַת אַהֲבָתֶֽךָ

hadur na'eh, ziv ha'olam, nafshi cholat ahavatach

Perfect, Pleasing, Radiance of the Universe, my soul is sick for your love.

((I am yearning)(2x) (yearning)(3x) for your love)(2x)
(We are yearning)(2x) (yearning)(3x) for your love

songs.title: Yishm'chu hashamayim
songs.lyrics:
יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם, וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ; יִרְעַם הַיָּם, וּמְלֹאוֹ

(yism'chu hashamayim (3x), vetagel ha'aretz)(2x),
(yir'am hayam (3x) umlo'o)(2x)

Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice;
let the sea and all within it thunder.

songs.title: Ya'aloz sadai
songs.lyrics:
יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כׇּל־עֲצֵי־יָעַר

(ya'aloz sadai v'chol asher bo
ya'aloz sadai (ay)(5x))(2x)
(az y'ran'nu kol atzei ya'ar)(4x)

Let the field and everything in them exalt; then all the trees of the forest shout for joy.

songs.title: Ana b'choach
songs.lyrics:
אָנָּא בְּכֹחַ גְּדֻלַּת יְמִינְךָ תַּתִּיר צְרוּרָה
קַבֵּל רִנַּת עַמְּךָ שגְּבֵנוּ טַהֲרֵנוּ נוֹרָא

ana b'choach gedulat y'mincha (tatir tzrura)(2x)
kabel (rinat (2x)) amcha sagveinu tahareinu norah.

Please, with the strength of your right hand,
untie our tangles.

songs.title: Tov l'hodot
songs.lyrics:
טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיי , וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן
לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּֽקֶר חַסְדֶּֽךָ, וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת

((tov l'hodot l'adonai)(2x),
(ulzamer)(2x) l'shimcha elyon, tov l'hodot l'adonai)(2x)
(l'hagid baboker chasdecha)(2x),
(v'emunatcha baleylot)(2x), tov l'hodot l'adonai.

It is good to praise God, to proclaim your steadfast love at daybreak, and your faithfulness each night.

songs.title: Tov l'hodot
songs.lyrics:
טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיי , וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן
לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּֽקֶר חַסְדֶּֽךָ, וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת

(tov l'hodot l'adonai ul'zameir l'shimcha elyon)(2x)
(l'hagid baboker chasdecha v'emunatcha baleilot)(2x)

It is good to praise God, to proclaim your steadfast love at daybreak, and your faithfulness each night.

songs.title: Oseh shalom
songs.lyrics:
עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ
וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ: אָמֵן

oseh shalom bim'romav, hu ya'aseh shalom aleinu
v'al kol yisra'eil v'al kol yoshvei teiveil v'imru amen

May the one who creates peace on high bring peace to us and to all Israel and to all who dwell on earth.
And we say: Amen.

songs.title: Mah yafeh hayom
songs.lyrics:
מַה־יָפֶה הַיוֹם שַׁבַּת שָׁלוֹם

(mah yafeh hayom, shabbat shalom)(2x)
(shabbat, shabbat shalom)(3x), shabbat shalom.

How beautiful this day is, Shabbat Shalom.

songs.title: Hinei el y'shu'ati
songs.lyrics:
הִנֵּה אֵל יְשׁוּעָתִי אֶבְטַח וְלֹא אֶפְחָד
כִּי עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ יְיָ וַיְהִי לִי לִישׁוּעָה
וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם מַֽיִם בְּשָׂשׂוֹן מִמַּעַיְנֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה
לַייָ הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶֽךָ סֶּֽלָה
יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עִמָּֽנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב, סֶֽלָה
יְיָ צְבָאוֹת אַשְרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵֽחַ בָּךְ
יְיָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ
לַיְּהוּדִים הָיְתָה אוֹרָה וְשִׂמְחָה
וְשָׂשׂוֹן וִיקָר כֵּן תִּהְיֶה לָּֽנוּ
כּוֹס יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא

hinei el y'shu'ati evtach v'lo efchad
ki ozi v'zimrat yah adonai vay'hi li lishu'ah
ushavtem mayim b'sason mima'aynei hay'shu'ah
la'adonai hay'shu'ah al am'cha virchatecha selah
adonai tz'va'ot imanu misgav lanu elohei ya'akov selah
adonai tz'va'ot ashrei adam bote'ach bach
adonai hoshi'ah hamelech ya'aneinu v'yom kor'einu
lay'hudim haytah orah v'simchah
v'sason vikar kein tihyeh lanu
kos y'shu'ot esa uv'shem adonai ekra

Behold, the God who gives me triumph.
I am confident, unafraid; for Adonai is my strength and might, and has been my deliverance.
Joyfully shall you draw water from the fountains of triumph; deliverance is Adonai's.
Your blessing be upon Your people.
Adonai Tz'vaot is with us; the God of Jacob is our haven.
Adonai Tz'vaot, happy is the one who trusts in You.
O Adonai, grant victory!
May the Sovereign answer us when we call.
The Jews enjoyed light and gladness, happiness and honor. So may it be for us.
I raise the cup of deliverance and invoke the name of Adonai.

songs.title: Havdalah blessings
songs.lyrics:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הַגָּֽפֶן

baruch atah adonai eloheinu melech ha'olam
(borei p'ri hagafen)(2x)

We praise You, Adonai our God, Sovereign of all, Creator of the fruit of the vine.

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא מִינֵי בְשָׂמִים

baruch atah adonai eloheinu melech ha'olam
(borei minei v'samim)(2x)

We praise You, Adonai our God, Sovereign of all, Creator of varied spices.

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא מְאוֹרֵי הָאֵשׁ

baruch atah adonai eloheinu melech ha'olam
(borei m'orei ha'esh)(2x)

We praise You, Adonai our God, Sovereign of all, Creator of the lights of fire.

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם,
הַמַּבְדִיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְחוֹל, בֵּין אוֹר לְחֹֽשֶׁךְ,
בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים,
בֵּין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵֽׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּבְדִיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְחוֹל.

baruch atah adonai eloheinu melech ha'olam
hamavdil bein kodesh l'chol bein or l'choshech
bein yisra'eil la'amim
bein yom hashvi'i l'sheishet y'mei hama'aseh
baruch atah adonai hamavdil bein kodesh l'chol

We praise You, Adonai our God, Sovereign of all, who distinguishes between holy and ordinary, between light and dark, between Israel and the nations, between the seventh day and the six days of work. We praise You, Adonai who distinguishes holy and ordinary.

songs.title: Separation piyyut
songs.lyrics:
הַמַּבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְחוֹל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ יִמְחוֹל
זַרְעֵנוּ וְכַסְפֵּֽנוּ יַרְבֶּה כַחוֹל
וְכַכּוֹכָבִים בַּלָּֽיְלָה
לִכְבוֹד חֶמְדַּת לְבָבִי אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא

hamavdil bein kodesh l'chol chatoteinu yimchol
zareinu v'chaspeinu yarbeh chachol
v'chakochavim balailah
(lichvod chemdat l'vavi eiliyahu hanavi)(2x)

May the one who distinguishes between holy and ordinary, forgive our wrongdoings; increase our descendants and our possessions like grains of sand and the stars at night. For our hearts' desire, Elijah the prophet.

songs.title: Shavua tov
songs.lyrics:
שָׁבוּעַ טוֹב

(shavua tov)(8x)

A good week

(A good week, a week of peace,
may gladness reign and joy increase)(2x)

songs.title: Eiliyahu hanavi
songs.lyrics:
אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא
אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי
אֵלִיָּהוּ הַגִּלְעָדִי
בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ
יָבוֹא אֵלֵינוּ
עִם מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד

eiliyahu hanavi
eiliyahu hatishbi
(eiliyahu)(3x) hagiladi
bimheirah v'yameinu
yavo eileinu
(im mashiach ben david)(2x)

May Elijah the prophet, Elijah the Tishbite, Elijah of Gilead, quickly in our day come to us heralding redemption.

songs.title: Bimheirah
songs.lyrics:
אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא
אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי
אֵלִיָּהוּ הַגִּלְעָדִי
בִּמְהֵרָה יָבוֹא אֵלֵינוּ
עִם מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד

(eiliyahu)(2x) hanavi
eiliyahu hanavi
eiliyahu hatishbi
eiliyahu hagiladi
(aye)(3x) bimheirah yavo eileinu
(im mashiach)(2x) ben david
bimheirah yavo eileinu
im (mashiach)(2x) ben david
[niggun]

May Elijah the prophet, Elijah the Tishbite, Elijah of Gilead, quickly come to us heralding redemption.

songs.title: Miriam han'viah
songs.lyrics:
מִרְיָם הַנְּביִאָה
עֹז וְזִמְרָה בְּיָדָהּ
מִרְיָם תִּרְקֹד אִתָּֽנוּ
לְהַגְדִּיל זִמְרַת עוֹלָם
מִרְיָם תִּרְקֹד אִתָּֽנוּ
לְתַקֵּן אֶת הָעוֹלָם
בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ הִיא תְּבִיאֵֽינוּ
אֶל מֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה

miriam han'viah
oz v'zimrah b'yadah
miriam tirkod itanu
l'hagdil zimrat olam
miriam tirkod itanu
l'takein et ha'olam
bimheirah v'yameinu hi t'vieinu
(el mei hay'shua)(2x)

Miriam the prophet, the power of song is in her hand. Miriam will dance among us and the music will be heard far and wide. Miriam will dance among us to mend our world of suffering. May she lead us, in our time, without delay, to the waters of help and healing.

songs.title: Miriam han'viah
songs.lyrics:
תִּקַּח מִרְיָם הַנְּבִיאָה אֶת־הַתֹּף בְּיָדֶיהָ
וַתֵּצֶאןָ כׇל־הַנָּשִׁים אַחֲרֶיהָ בְּתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלֹת

(tikach eleha miryam hanevi'a et hatof b'yadeha)(2x)
(vateitze-vateitzena kol hanashim achareha
vateitze-vateitzena)(2x)
(betupim uvimcholot vateitze-vateitzena)(2x)

The prophet Miriam takes the drum to her hands, and all the women came out after her, in drums and in dance

songs.title: Miriam han'viah
songs.lyrics:
מִרְיָם הַנְּביִאָה
עֹז וְזִמְרָה בְּיָדָהּ
מִרְיָם תִּרְקֹד אִתָּנוּ
לְהַגְדִּיל זִמְרַת עוֹלָם
מִרְיָם תִּרְקֹד אִתָּנוּ
לְתַקֵּן אֶת הָעוֹלָם
בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ הִיא תְּבִיאֵינוּ
אֶל מֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה

(miriam han'viah
(oz)(2x) v'zimrah b'yadah)(2x)
(bimheirah v'yameinu hi t'vieinu
(el)(2x) mei hay'shu'a)(2x)
miriam tirkod itanu
l'hagdil zimrat olam
miriam tirkod itanu
l'takein et ha'olam
(bimheirah v'yameinu hi t'vieinu
(el)(2x) mei hay'shu'a)(2x)

Miriam the prophet, the power of song is in her hand. Miriam will dance among us and the music will be heard far and wide. Miriam will dance among us to mend our world of suffering. May she lead us, in our time, without delay, to the waters of help and healing.

songs.title: Buena semana
songs.lyrics:
(Buena semana mos de el Diyo)(2x)
(Buena semana mos de el Diyo, salud i vida)(2x)
(Ke miz fijos vengan al kal)(2x)
(Para maldar la tora, salud i vida)(2x)
(Para maldar kon talesim)(2x)
(Para trayer los tefilin, salud i vida)(2x)

May God give us a good week. Health and life. May my children come to the synagogue to study torah, to pray with talit, to wear tefilin.

songs.title: Hodu
songs.lyrics:
הוֹדוּ לַיְיָ כִּי טוֹב, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
יֹאמַר נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
יֹאמְרוּ נָא בֵית אַהֲרֹן, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
יֹאמְרוּ נָא יִרְאֵי יְיָ, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ

(hodu l'adonai ki tov, ki l'olam chasdo)(2x)
yomar na yisra'eil, ki l'olam chasdo
hodu l'adonai ki tov, (ki l'olam chasdo)(2x)
yomru na veit aharon, ki l'olam chasdo
hodu l'adonai ki tov, ki l'olam chasdo
yomru na yir'ei adonai, ki l'olam chasdo
hodu l'adonai ki tov, (ki l'olam chasdo)(2x)

Offer gratitude to God, who is good, whose lovingkindness is eternal!
Let Israel declare: God's steadfast love is eternal!
Let the house of Aaron declare: God's steadfast love is eternal!
Let those who are in awe of God declare: God's steadfast love is eternal!

הוֹדוּ לַיְיָ כִּי טוֹב, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
הוֹדוּ, לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
הוֹדוּ, לַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ

hodu l'adonai ki tov, ki l'olam chasdo
hodu leilohei ha'elohim, ki l'olam chasdo
hodu l'adonei ha'adonim, ki l'olam chasdo
l'osei nifla'ot g'dolot l'vado, (ki l'olam chasdo)(2x)

Offer gratitude to God, who is good, whose lovingkindness is eternal!
Offer gratitude to the God of gods, whose steadfast love is eternal!
Offer gratitude to the ruler above all rulers, whose steadfast love is eternal,
who alone works great marvels, whose steadfast love is eternal!

songs.title: Min hameitzar
songs.lyrics:
מִן הַמֵּצַר קָרָאתִי יָּהּ, עָנָּנִי בַמֶרְחַב יָהּ
יי לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם

From the narrow I called to the Lord,
God answered me in the great freedom of space.

songs.title: Ozi v'zimrat
songs.lyrics:
עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי לִי לִישׁוּעָה

ozi v'zimrat yah vay'hi li lishuah

God is my strength and might.
God has become my deliverance.

זֹאת אֵלָתִי וְאַנְוֵהָ אֱלֹהֹת אִמִּי וַאֲרֹמְמֶנְהָ

(elohot)(4x)

(vat'hi li)(2x) lishu'ah)(2x)

songs.title: Pitchu li
songs.lyrics:
פִּתְחוּ לִי שַׁעֲרֵי צֶדֶק, אָבֹא בָם, אוֹדֶה יָהּ
זֶה הַשַּׁעַר לַיְיָ, צַדִּיקִים יָבֹאוּ בוֹ

(pitchu li sha'arei tzedek, avo vam odeh yah)(2x)
(zeh hasha'ar l'Adonai, tzadikim yavo'u vo)(2x)

Open the gates of righteousness, so I may enter to praise God. The righteous shall enter through God's gateway.

songs.title: Zeh hayom
songs.lyrics:
זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְיָ נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ

zeh hayom asah adonai nagilah v'nismechah vo

This is the day that God has made.
Let us be joyful and rejoice in it.

songs.title: Zeh hayom
songs.lyrics:
זֶה הַיּום עָשה ה'. נָגִילָה וְנִשמְחָה בו
זֶה הַיּום נִחְיֶה בְּיַחַד. נָגִילָה וְנִשמְחָה בו

(zeh hayom asah adonai. nagila v'nismekha vo)(8x)
(zeh hayom nikhyeh b'yakhad. nagila v'nismekha vo)(8x)

This is the day that God has made.
Let us be joyful and rejoice in it
This is the day we will live together.
Let us be joyful and rejoice in it

songs.title: Eili atah
songs.lyrics:
אֵלִי אַתָּה וְאוֹדֶךָּ ,אֱלֹהַי אֲרוֹמְמֶךָּ
הוֹדוּ לַיי כִּי טוֹב, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ

eili atah v'odeka, elohai arom'meka
(hodu l'adonai ki tov, ki l'olam chasdo)(2x)

You are my God, and I praise and exalt you. Give thanks to God, for God is good; God's kindness endures forever.

songs.title: Ki mei'olam
songs.lyrics:
כִּי מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל

((ki mei'olam)(2x) v'ad olam
ki mei'olam v'ad olam)(2x)
(ki mei'olam)(2x) v'ad olam atah el
(ki mei'olam v'ad olam)(2x) atah el

Before time and forever You are The Source of Life.

songs.title: Kiddush l'vanah
songs.lyrics:
וְלַלְּבָנָה אָמַר שֶׁתִּתְחַדֵּשׁ
עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת לַעֲמוּסֵי בָטֶן
שֶׁהֵם עֲתִידִים לְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ כְּמוֹתָהּ

v'lalvanah amar (shetitchadeish)(2x)
ateret tiferet la'amusay vaten
(sheheim atidim l'hitchadeish k'motah)(2x)

And God said “Renew yourself, moon.” Crown to us all living beneath you, destined to be renewed just like you.

songs.title: Od y'nuvun
songs.lyrics:
עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ

(od y'nuvun b'seivah)(2x)
(d'sheinim v'ra'ananim yehiyu)(2x)
(od y'nuvun b'seivah d'sheinim v'ra'ananim)(2x)
(yehiyu)(6x)
[niggun]
(od y'nuvun b'seivah d'sheinim v'ra'ananim)(2x)

In old age the righteous still produce fruit;
they are full of sap and aliveness.

Like the fruit of the vine, ripening in its time
like the fruit of the vine, bringing sweetness of the divine

songs.title: Turn me back
songs.lyrics:
(Turning, turning, and returning
Turn me back to (you)/(me))(2x)

הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ  אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה

hashiveinu adonai eilecha
hashiveinu adonai v'nashuva

Take us back, God, to yourself, and let us come back.

songs.title: A'hallela
songs.lyrics:
אֲהַלְלָה יְיָ בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
אַל תִּבְטְחוּ בִנְדִיבִים בְּבֶן־אָדָם שֶׁאֵֽין לוֹ תְשׁוּעָה
תֵּצֵא רוּחוֹ יָשֻׁב לְאַדְמָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָבְדוּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָיו׃
אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁאֵל יַעֲקֹב בְּעֶזְרוֹ שִׂבְרוֹ עַל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו׃

(a'hallela adonai b'chayai azam'ra l'elohai b'odi)(2x)
(al tivtichu vin'divim
b'ven adam she'ein lo t'shu'ah
teitzei rucho yashuv l'admato
bayom hahu av'du eshtonotav)(2x)
(ashrei she'eil ya'akov b'ezro, sivro al adonai elohav)(2x)

I will praise God all my life, make music to my God while I still exist. Don't put your trust in oligarchs, in humans who cannot save. Their breath departs, they return to the dust, and then their plans come to nothing. Happy is the one who has the God of Jacob for their help, whose hope is in Adonai their God.

songs.title: Adonai ori
songs.lyrics:
יְיָ  אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא יְיָ מָעוֹז־חַיַּי
מִמִּי אֶפְחָד
אַחַת  שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ
כׇּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְיָ וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ

adonai ori v'yish'i, mimi ira, adonai ma'oz chayai
mimi ef'chad
(achat sha'alti mei'eit adonai
otah avakeish, shivti b'veit adonai
(kol y'mei chayai lachazot
b'noam adonai ul'vakeir b'heichalo)(2x))(2x)

God is my light and my help, whom should I fear?
God is the stronghold of my life, whom should I dread?
All I ask of you, God, is to live in your house all the days of my life, to gaze upon your beauty, to visit your temple.

songs.title: Achat sha'alti
songs.lyrics:
אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ, אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ
שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְיָ
וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ

(achat sha'alti mei'eit adonai otah avakeish)(2x)
(shivti b'veit adonai kol y'mei chayai)(2x)

(One thing I ask of you oh God

This is all I ask)(2x)

(Let me live in the shelter of your house

All the days of my life)(2x)

songs.title: Achat sha'alti
songs.lyrics:
אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ, אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ
שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְיָ

to live in the house of the Lord
all the days of my life
to gaze upon the beauty of God

One thing I ask of God
only this do I seek
to live in the house of the Lord
all the days of my life
to gaze upon the beauty of God
to return again and again to the Holy palace

songs.title: Koli ekra
songs.lyrics:
שְׁמַע־יְיָ קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא וְחׇנֵּנִי וַעֲנֵנִיי

(v'choneini oh va'aneini)(2x)
(koli ekra)(4x)
(shema (havayah)(2x) (shema)(2x))(2x)

Hear God when I cry aloud;
have mercy on me, answer me.

songs.lyrics:
שְׁמַע־יְיָ קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא

((shema adonai koli ekra)(3x) koli ekra)(2x)

Hear God when I cry aloud

(Hold me and I will follow)(6x) koli ekra

songs.title: Kaveih
songs.lyrics:
וּלֵא הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּטוּב יְיָ בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים
קַוֵּה אֶל יְיָ חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל יְיָ

(lulei (he'emanti lir'ot)(2x) b'tuv adonai b'eretz chayim)(2x)
((kaveih)(2x) el adonai chazak v'ya'ameitz libecha v'kaveih el adonai)(2x)

[And my enemies would already have destroyed me] had I not believed in seeing God’s goodness in the land of the living.
Look to God; be strong, and let your heart take courage, and [if your prayer is not answered, then, again,] hope to God.

songs.title: Mima'amakim
songs.lyrics:
מִמַּעֲמַקִּים קְרָאתִיךָ יְיָ
יְיָ שִׁמְעָה בְקוֹלִי תִּהְיֶינָה אׇזְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁבוֹת לְקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי

(mima'amakim k'raticha havayah mima'amakim k'raticha)(2x)
(adonai shim'ah b'koli tihyenah oznecha kashuvot l'kol tachanunai)(2x)

Out of the depths I call You, God. Hear my cry; let your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

songs.title: Makom bina
songs.lyrics:
וְהַחׇכְמָה מֵאַיִן תִּמָּצֵא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָה
הֵן יִרְאַת יְיָ הִיא חׇכְמָה וְסוּר מֵרָע בִּינָה

((v'hachochmah mei'ayin timatzei, v'ei zeh makom bina)(2x)
v'ei zeh makom bina)(2x)
(hein yir'at adonai hi chochmah, (v'sur)(2x) meira bina)(2x)

[niggun]

Wisdom, where can it be found?
Where is the place of true knowledge?
The fear of God, that is wisdom.
Departing from sin, that is true knowledge.

songs.title: Ki anu amecha
songs.lyrics:
כִּי אָֽנוּ עַמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
אָֽנוּ בָנֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה אָבִֽינוּ
אָֽנוּ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה אֲדוֹנֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ קְהָלֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה חֶלְקֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה גוֹרָלֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ צֹאנֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה רוֹעֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ כַרְמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה נוֹטְרֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ פְעֻלָּתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ רַעְיָתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה דוֹדֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ סְגֻלָּתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
אָֽנוּ עַמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה מַלְכֵּֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ מַאֲמִירֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה מַאֲמִירֵֽנוּ

ki anu amecha v'atah eloheinu
anu vanecha v'atah avinu
anu avadecha v'atah adoneinu
anu kehalecha v'atah chelkeinu
anu nachalatecha v'atah goraleinu
anu tzonecha v'atah ro'einu
anu charmecha v'atah notreinu
anu f'ulatecha v'atah yotzreinu
anu ra'yatecha v'atah dodeinu
anu segulatecha v'atah eloheinu
anu amecha v'atah malkeinu
anu ma'amirecha v'atah ma'amireinu

For we are your people; and you are our God.
We are your children; and you are our parent.
We are your servants; and you are our master.
We are your congregation; and you are our portion.
We are your inheritance; and you are our destiny.
We are your flock; and you are our shepherd.
We are your vineyard; and you are our keeper.
We are your work; and you are our creator.
We are your dear ones and you are our beloved.
We are your treasure; and you are our God.
We are your people; and you are our ruler.
We are your distinguished ones; and you are our distinction.

songs.title: Gesher
songs.lyrics:
כָּל הַעוֺלַם כּוּלוֺ, גֶשֶׁר צַר מְאוֺד, וְהַעִיקַר לֺא לְפַחֵּד כְלַל

(kol ha'olam kulo gesher tzar me'od
kol ha'olam kulo gesher tzar)(3x)
kol ha'olam kulo gesher tzar me'od
kol ha'olam kulo gesher

The whole entire world is a very narrow bridge,
but the main thing to recall is to not fear everything.

songs.title: Awaken
songs.lyrics:
Awaken my soul (4x)

We cause harm
We get hurt
We are broken
And so we learn

We hurt our loved ones
When we don't know
We wound the earth
And so we grow

We say mean words
And take wrong turns
We can't reverse
So we sing this verse

We own up
'Cause we are strong
And flexible
This road is long

Awaken my soul (4x)

And every time
We fall again
We remind ourselves
That we can mend

With open hearts
We turn to you
Oh universe
Help me see this change through

Awaken my soul (8x)

(We put all of our
Stubbornness aside
Expose our fragility
And let you guide)(2x)

Awaken my soul (4x)

songs.title: Lishmo'a
songs.lyrics:
בְּמוֹצָאֵי מְנוּחָה
קִדַּמְנוּךָ תְּחִלָּה
הַט אָזְנְךָ מִמָּרוֹם
יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלָּה
לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה
וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה

b'motza'ei m'nuchah
kidam'nucha t'chilah
hat ozn'cha mimarom
yosheiv t'hilah
lishmo'a (el harinah)(2x)
v'el hat'filah

After the departure of the Sabbath
We approach You [in prayer]
Incline Your ear from on high
You Who are enthroned upon praises
Listen to the song
And to the prayer

אֶל־הָרִנָּה וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה

(lishmo'a (el harinah)(2x) v'el hat'filah)(2x)

Listen to the song
To the song and to the prayer

אֶת־יְמִין עֹז עוֹרְרָה
לַעֲשׂוֹת חָיִל
בְּצֶדֶק נֶעֱקַד
וְנִשְׁחַט תְּמוּרוֹ אָיִל
גְּנוֹן נָא גִזְעוֹ
בְּזַעֲקָם בְּעוֹד לָיִל
לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה
וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה

et y'min oz or'rah
la'asot chayil
b'tzedek ne'ekad
v'nishchat t'muro ayil
g'non na giz'o
b'za'akam b'od layil
lishmo'a el harinah
v'el hat'filah

Raise Your mighty, right hand
To act valiantly
For the righteous one, who was bound
and in whose stead a ram was slain
Shield his descendants
As they cry to You while it is yet night
Listen to the song
And to the prayer

CHORUS

דְּרוֹשׁ־נָא דּוֹרְשֶׁיךָ
בְּדָרְשָׁם פָּנֶיךָ
הִדָּרֶשׁ לָמוֹ מִשְּׁמֵי מְעוֹנֶךָ
וּלְשַׁוְעַת חִנּוּנָם
אַל תַּעְלֵם אָזְנֶךָ
לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה
וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה

d'roshna dorshecha
b'dorsham panecha
hidaresh lamo
mishmei m'onecha
ul'shav'at chinunam
al talem oznecha
lishmo'a el harinah
v'el hat'filah

Turn to those who seek You
When they seek Your Presence
Be accessible to them
From Your Heavenly Abode
And to the cry of their supplication
Close not Your ear
Listen to the song
And to the prayer

CHORUS

זוֹחֲלִים וְרוֹעֲדִים
מִיּוֹם בֹּאֶךָ
חָלִים כְּמַבְכִּירָה
מֵעֶבְרַת מַשָּׂאֶךָ
טִנּוּפָם מְחֵה נָא
וְיוֹדוּ פְּלָאֶיךָ
לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה
וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה

zochalim v'ro'adim
miyom bo'echa
chalim k'mavkirah
mei'evrat masa'echa
tinufam m'cheih na
v'yodu p'la'echa
lishmo'a el harinah
v'el hat'filah

They tremble and quake
At the day of Your arrival
They are panic-struck
As a woman giving birth the first time
From the burning wrath You carry
O please, wipe away their filth
That they may praise Your wonders
Listen to the song
And to the prayer

CHORUS

יוֹצֵר אַתָּה
לְכָל־יְצִיר נוֹצָר
כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵאָז תֶּרֶף
לְחַלְּצָם מִמֵּצָר
לְחוֹנְנָם חִנָּם
מֵאוֹצָר הַמְּנֻצָּר
לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה
וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה

yotzeir atah
l'chol y'tzir notzar
konanta mei'az teref
l'chaltzam mimeitzar
l'chon'nam chinam
mei'otzar ham'nutzar
lishmo'a el harinah
v'el hat'filah

You are the Creator
Of all that is formed
You prepared from of old
A remedy to save them from distress
By bestowing undeserved grace upon them from Your hidden treasure
Listen to the song
And to the prayer

(CHORUS)(2x)

songs.title: Ya'aleh koleinu
songs.lyrics:
יַעֲלֶה תַחֲנוּנֵנוּ מֵעֶרֶב
וְיָבֹא שַׁוְעָתֵנוּ מִבֹּקֶר
וְיֵרָאֶה רִנּוּנֵנוּ עַד עָרֶב
יַעֲלֶה קוֹלֵנוּ מֵעֶרֶב
יַעֲלֶה יַעֲלֶה יַעֲלֶה, יַעֲלֶה קוֹלֵנוּ

ya'aleh tachanuneinu mei'erev
v'yavo shav'ateinu miboker
v'yeira'eh rinuneinu ad arev
ya'aleh koleinu mei'erev
((ya'aleh)(3x) ya'aleh koleinu)(2x)
[niggun]

Let our needs rise up with the darkness,
our cries with the rays of the sun.
All day our praise is before you,
songs of joy and bliss till evening comes.

songs.title: Adon has'lichot
songs.lyrics:
אֲדוֹן הַסְּלִיחוֹת. בּוֹחֵן לְבָבוֹת. גּוֹלֶה עֲמוּקוֹת. דּוֹבֵר צְדָקוֹת. חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ׃

adon has'lichot, bochein l'vavot
goleh amukot, doveir tz'dakot
(chatanu l'fanecha racheim aleinu)(2x)

Awesome God, Beneficent and good to all your creatures, Clothed in right, Declaring truth, God we have sinned before you; have mercy on us.

הָדוּר בְּנִפְלָאוֹת. וָתִיק בְּנֶֽחָמוֹת. זוֹכֵר בְּרִית אָבוֹת. חוֹקֵר כְּלָיוֹת׃ חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ׃

hadur b'nifla'ot, vatik b'nechamot
zocheir b'rit avot, chokeir k'layot
(chatanu l'fanecha racheim aleinu)(2x)

Ever constant in comforts, Foreseeing, Glorious in wonders, Hearkening to prayers, God we have sinned before you; have mercy on us.

טוֹב וּמֵטִיב לַבְּרִיּוֹת. יוֹדֵעַ כָּל־נִסְתָּרוֹת. כּוֹבֵשׁ עֲוֺנוֹת. לוֹבֵשׁ צְדָקוֹת׃ חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ׃

tov umeitiv labriyot, yodei'a kol nistarot
koveish avonot, loveish tz'dakot
(chatanu l'fanecha racheim aleinu)(2x)

Invoking the generations, Judging in knowledge, Knowing all that is hidden, Lord of forgiveness. Moving over the skies, God we have sinned before you; have mercy on us.

מָלֵא זָֽכִיּוֹת .נוֹרָא תְהִלּוֹת. סוֹלֵֽחַ עֲוֺנוֹת. עוֹנֶה בַצָּרוֹת׃ חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ׃

malei zachiyot, nora t'hilot
solei'ach avonot, oneh vatzarot
(chatanu l'fanecha racheim aleinu)(2x)

Nigh in trouble, overflowing in virtue, Pardoning sins, Quelling sinfulness, Remembering the covenant with the fathers, God we have sinned before you;have mercy on us.

פּוֹעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת .צוֹפֶה עֲתִידוֹת.קוֹרֵא הַדּוֹרוֹת. רוֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת .שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלּוֹת. תְּמִים דֵּעוֹת׃ חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ׃

po'eil yeshu'ot, tzofeh atidot
korei hadorot, rocheiv aravot
shomei'a t'filot, t'mim dei'ot
(chatanu l'fanecha racheim aleinu)(4x)

Searcher of inmost feelings, Tester of hearts, Uncovering the depths, Venerated in praises, Working salvation, God we have sinned before you;have mercy on us.

songs.title: Passing through
songs.lyrics:
((Passing through)(2x)
We are only passing through)(2x)

הַנְּשָׁמָה לָךְ וְהַגּוּף פָּעֳלָךְ

(han'shamah n'shamah lach v'haguf po'alach)(2x)

The soul is Yours, and the body is Your handiwork.

songs.title: Tzama lecha nafsi
songs.lyrics:
צָמְאָה לְךָ  נַפְשִׁי כָּמַהּ לְךָ בְשָׂרִי בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּה וְעָיֵף בְּלִי־מָיִם
כֵּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ חֲזִיתִךָ לִרְאוֹת עֻזְּךָ וּכְבוֹדֶךָ

tzamah l'cha nafshi kamah l'kha v'sari
b'eretz tziyah v'ayef b'li mayim
(ken bakodesh chazitikha lirot uz'cha uch'vodekha)(3x)

God, You are my God; I search for You, my soul thirsts for You, my body yearns for You, as a parched and thirsty land that has no water.
I shall behold You in the sanctuary, and see Your might and glory.

songs.title: El nora alilah
songs.lyrics:
CHORUS:

אֵל נוֹרָא עֲלִילָה
הַמְצִיא לָנוּ מְחִילָה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

((el nora alilah)(2x)
hamtzi lanu m'chilah, bish'at han'ilah)(2x)

Awe-inspiring creator, forgive us in this closing hour.

CHORUS

מְתֵי מִסְפָּר קְרוּאִים, לְךָ עַיִן נוֹשְׂאִים
וּמְסַלְּדִים בְּחִילָה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

m'tei mispar k'ruim, l'cha ayin nos'im
um'saldim b'chilah, bish'at han'ilah

We who are called “few in number”
raise our eyes toward You,
and tremblingly beseech You, in this closing hour.

CHORUS

שׁוֹפְכִים לְךָ נַפְשָׁם, מְחֵה פִּשְׁעָם וְכַחְשַׁם
וְהַמְצִיאֵם מְחִילָה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

shof'chim l'cha nafsham, m'cheih pisham v'chachsham
v'hamtzi'eim m'chilah, bish'at han'ilah

As we pour out our souls,
wipe away our sins and denials,
craft forgiveness for us, in this closing hour.

CHORUS

הֱיֵה לָהֶם לְסִתְרָה, וְהַצִילֵם מִמְּאֵרָה
וְחָתְמֵם לְהוֹד וּלְגִילָה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

heyeih lahem l'sitrah, v'hatzileim mim'eirah
v'chotmeim l'hod ul'gilah, bish'at han'ilah

Be our protector. Shield us from terror;
seal our fate for joy and glory in this closing hour.

CHORUS

חוֹן אוֹתָם וְרַחֵם, וְכָל לוֹחֵץ וְלוֹחֵם
עֲשֵׂה בָּהֶם פְּלִילָה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

chon otam v'racheim, v'chol locheitz v'locheim
aseih bahem p'lilah, bish'at han'ilah

Be compassionate and loving toward us;
bring judgment on all
who would oppress us, in this closing hour.

CHORUS

זְכֹר צִדְקַת אֲבִיהֶם, וְחַדֵּשׁ אֶת יְמֵיהֶם
כְּקֶדֶם וּתְחִלָּה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

z'chor tzid'kat avihem, v'chadeish et y'meihem
k'kedem ut'chillah, bish'at han'ilah

Remember our ancestors' righteousness
and renew our days,
as of old and as at the beginning, in this closing hour.

CHORUS

קְרָא נָּא שְׁנַת רָצוֹן, וְהָשֵׁב שְׁאָר הַצֹּאן
לְאָהֳלִיבָה וְאָהֳלָה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

k'ra na sh'nat ratzon, v'hasheiv sh'ar hatzon
l'oholivah v'oholah, bish'at han'ilah

May this year be one which is pleasing to You.
Restore Your remaining flock
to their former glory in this closing hour.

CHORUS

תִּזְכּוּ לְשָׁנִים רַבּוֹת, הַבָּנִים וְהָאָבוֹת
בְּדִיצָה וּבְצָהֳלָה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

tizku l'shanim rabot, habanim v'ha'avot
b'ditzah uv'tzoholah, bish'at han'ilah

May we, Your children, celebrate with joy and gladness,
length of days merited in this closing hour.

CHORUS

מִיכָאֵל שַׂר יִשְׂרָאֵל, אֵלִיָּהוּ וְגַבְרִיאֵל
בַּשְּׂרוּ נָא הַגְּאֻלָּה, בִּשְׁעַת הַנְּעִילָה

micha'eil sar yisra'eil, eliyahu v'gavri'eil
basru na hag'ulah, bish'at han'ilah

May Michael, protector of Israel, Elijah, and Gabriel
bring tidings of redemption in this closing hour.

(CHORUS)(2x)

songs.title: Hin'ni
songs.lyrics:
הִנְנִי בָּאתִי לַעֲמֹד וּלְחַנֵּן לְפָנֶיךָ
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה

(hin'ni)(8x) (bati la'amod u'l'chanen l'fanecha)(2x)
(baruch atah shome'ah t'filah)(2x)

Here I am. I came here before You to plead.
Blessed are You, the One who hears our prayers.

songs.title: Hashiveini
songs.lyrics:
הֲשִׁיבֵנִי וְאָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם

(hashiveini v'ashuvah)(2x) chadeish
((chadeish)(2x) yameinu k'kedem)(2x)

Receive me back so I may return to my true self, renew our days to their essence.

songs.title: Nigun t'shuvah
songs.lyrics:
רָאוּי לָנוּ לַחֲזֹר בִּתְשׁוּבָה
וְלַעֲזֹב רִשְׁעֵנוּ
שֶׁהָרְשׁוּת עַתָּה בְּיָדֵינוּ

(ra'ui lanu lachzor bit'shuvah)(4x)
((v'la'azov risheinu)(2x)
ra'ui lanu lachzor bit'shuvah)(2x)
((sheharshut atah b'yadeinu)(3x)
ra'ui lanu lachzor bit'shuvah)(2x)

It is proper for us to repent and abandon our wickedness, for this choice is presently in our hand.

(We return to do t'shuvah)(4x)
(To release our cycles
Own up to mistakes
We return to do t'shuvah)(2x)

(We choose to repair harm
We choose to shift our ways
We choose to learn and unlearn
We return to do t'shuvah)(2x)
songs.notes: Intro: This song quotes a passage from the Mishneh Torah where Miamondes emphasizes that we have a choice to do t'shuvah. It is in our hands, and during this holy time is the time we choose.

songs.title: Zochreinu l'chayim
songs.lyrics:
זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים
וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים
לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים

zochreinu l'chayim
melech chafeitz bachayim
(v'chotveinu b'seifer hachayim
l'ma'ancha elohim chayim)(2x)
(l'ma'ancha)(2x) elohim chayim
(l'ma'ancha)(3x) elohim chayim

Remember us for life, Sovereign Who delights in life
And write us into the Book of Life
for Your sake, living God

songs.title: We return
songs.lyrics:
((We return)(5x) return again)(2x)
and again to (love/truth)(3x)
we return again to love/truth

הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ  אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם

hashiveinu adonai eilecha v'nashuvah
chadeish yameinu k'kedem

Take us back, God, to Yourself, And let us come back; Renew our days as of old!

songs.title: Who by fire
songs.lyrics:
And who by fire, who by water
Who in the sunshine, who in the night time
Who by high ordeal, who by common trial
Who in your merry merry month of May
Who by very slow decay
And who shall I say is calling?

And who in her lonely slip, who by barbiturate
Who in these realms of love, who by something blunt
And who by avalanche, who by powder
Who for his greed, who for his hunger
And who shall I say is calling?

And who by brave assent, who by accident
Who in solitude, who in this mirror
Who by his lady's command, who by his own hand
Who in mortal chains, who in power
And who shall I say is calling?

songs.title: Hineini
songs.lyrics:
נִדְרַשְׁתִּי לְלוֹא שָׁאָלוּ נִמְצֵאתִי לְלֹא בִקְשֻׁנִי
אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּנִי הִנֵּנִי

(nidrashti l'lo sha'alu
nimtzeti l'lo vikshuni
amarti (hineni)(3x))(2x)
(amarti hineni)(3x) hineni

I responded to those who did not ask,
I was at hand to those who did not seek Me;
I said, “Here I am, here I am,”

songs.title: Hineih Ani
songs.lyrics:
הִנֵּה אֲנִי, כּוּלִּי שֶׁלְּךָ
עֲשֵׂה בִּי כִּרְצוֹנְךָ
בָּאתִי רֵיק, אֲנִי נִכְנָע
לִבִּי נָתוּן לְחַסְדֶּךָ
גַּם אִם הַכֹּל יִשָּׁלֵל מִמֶּנִּי
בְּתוֹכִי קוֹלְךָ אֶשְׁמַע
מִן הַכְּאֵב הוּא יָרִימֵנִי
יְמַלֵּא לִבִּי בְּהַשְׁרָאָה

(hineih ani kuli shelcha
aseih bi kirtzoncha)(2x)
(bati reik ani nichna
libi natun l'chasdecha)(2x)
(gam im hakol yishaleil mimeni
b'tochi kolcha eshma)(2x)
(min hak'eiv hu yarimeini
y'malei libi b'hashra'a)(2x)

Here I am, completely yours. Do as you will with me
I've come empty, I surrender. My heart is at your mercy
Even if everything is taken away from me
Within me, I will hear your voice.
From the pain, it will resurrect me
And fill me with inspiration.

songs.title: Eilah
songs.lyrics:
מִן הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם, אַתְּ אֵלָה
רוּחַ כָּל בָּשָׂר תְּפָאֵר וּתְרוֹמֵם זִכְרֵךְ
פּוֹדָה וּמַצִּילָה. וְעוֹנָה וּמְרַחֶמֶת
אֵין לָנוּ מַלְכָּה אֶלָּא אַתְּ

((min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam, at eilah)(2x)

(eilah)(12x))(2x)
(ruach kol basar t'fa'eir ut'romeim zichreich)(8x)
((podah)(4x) (podah umatzilah)(2x)
(podah umatzilah v'onah)(2x) (um'rachemet)(4x))(2x)
((ein lanu malkah)(3x) ela at)(4x)

From eternity to eternity, you are Goddess. The spirit of all flesh will glorify and exalt your memory. Liberates and rescues, redeems and saves. Aside from you we have no Queen but you.

songs.title: V'hasheivota
songs.lyrics:
וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ
כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים
וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ
לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא
יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד
וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד

(v'hasheivota el l'vavecha
ki adonai hu ha'elohim)(4x)
v'ne'emar vehayah adonai
l'melech al kol ha'aretz
(baiyom hahu)(2x)
yihyeh adonai echad
(ushemo)(3x) echad

Take it to heart that Adonai is surely God. And God shall rule over all the earth. On that day God will be one, God's name will be one.

songs.title: Renew
songs.lyrics:
((Renew)(3x) our bodies
(Renew)(2x) our soul)(2x)
(We will return to you)(4x)

songs.title: Ulu ushpizin
songs.lyrics:
עוּלוּ אוּשְׁפִּיזִין עִלָּאִין קַדִּישִׁין
עוּלוּ אִימָּהָתָא עִלָּאָתָא קְדִּישָׁתָא
עוּלוּ אֲבָהָן עִלָּאִין קַדִּישִׁין

(ulu ushpizin ila'in kadishin)(4x) (ulu)(19x)
(ulu imahata ila'ata k'dishata)(4x) (ulu)(19x)
(ulu avahan ila'in kadishin)(4x) (ulu)(19x)

Come in exalted holy guests
Come in exalted holy mothers
Come in exalted holy fathers

songs.title: Turn turn turn
songs.lyrics:
CHORUS:
To everything - turn, turn, turn
There is a season - turn, turn, turn
And a time to every purpose under heaven

A time to be born, a time to die
A time to plant, a time to reap
A time to kill, a time to heal
A time to laugh, a time to weep

CHORUS

A time to build up, a time to break down
A time to dance, a time to mourn
A time to cast away stones
A time to gather stones together

CHORUS

A time of love, a time of hate
A time of war, a time of peace
A time you may embrace
A time to refrain from embracing

CHORUS

A time to gain, a time to lose
A time to rend, a time to sew
A time for love, a time for hate
A time for peace, I swear it's not too late!

CHORUS

songs.title: Vayavdel
songs.lyrics:
בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹשֶׁךְ, וַיַּבְדֵּל, יְהִי אוֹר

((bein ha'or u'vein ha'choshech)(2x)
(vayavdel)(6x))(3x)
(y'hi or)(9x)

God separated the light from the darkness. There was light.

songs.title: T'filat geshem
songs.lyrics:
מַשִּׁיב הָרוּחַ וּמוֹרִיד הַגֶּשֶׁם

(mashiv ha'ruach u'morid hageshem)(4x)

God makes the wind blow and rain fall

((For our sake)(2x) don't hold back the water)(4x)

(Don't hold back the water)(8x)

Remember Miriam whose prophecy flowed like water, She watched her brother float down the Nile water, Crossed the sea with thousands through the water,
And in the desert, wherever she went, there was water.

(For Miriam's sake, don't hold back the water)(2x)
((For our sake)(2x) don't hold back the water)(2x)

(Don't hold back the water)(8x)

songs.title: Kamayim
songs.lyrics:
כַּ֭מַּיִם הַפָּנִ֣ים לַפָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב־הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לָאָדָֽם

((kamayim)(3x) hapanim lapanim)(2x)
((kein lev ha'adam)(3x) la'adam)(2x)

Just as the face of water reflects a face
so does the human heart reflect the person.

songs.title: Down to the well
songs.lyrics:
I will go down to the well
Let the water ring me like a bell
Let the water rock me like a child
For this well will not run dry
No, this well will not run dry

songs.title: Mimainei
songs.lyrics:
מִמַּעַיְנֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה

שְׁאַבְתֶּם מַיִם בְּשָׂשׂוֹן

mimainei hayeshua
shavtem mayim b'sason

We will draw water in celebration
From the wellsprings of liberation

מַיִם חַיִּים

mayim chayim

living waters

songs.title: Mayim
songs.lyrics:
וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם מַיִם בְּשָׂשׂוֹן מִמַּעַיְנֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה

Ushavtem mayim be'sason mimaynei hayeshua

With joy we draw water out of the wells of salvation.

songs.title: I am light
songs.lyrics:
CHORUS:
I am light, I am light
I am light, I am light
I am light, I am light
I am light, I am light

I am not the things my family did
I am not the voices in my head
I am not the pieces of the brokenness inside
I am light, I am light

CHORUS

I'm not the mistakes that I have made
Or any of the things that caused me pain
I am not the pieces of the dream I left behind
I am light, I am light

CHORUS

I am not the color of my eyes
I am not the skin on the outside
I am not my age
I am not my race
My soul inside is all light, all light

I am light, I am light
I am light, I am light
I am divinity defined
I am the God on the inside
I am a star, a piece of it all
I am light

songs.title: G'vurah
songs.lyrics:
You wake us up from our sleep
To fight for (our humanity)/(our community)/(solidarity)
'Til everyone is free
Guided by our biggest light
Love is part of how we fight
M'chayei meitim (מְחַיֵּה מֵּתִים)
(And I pray pray pray for our strength strength strength And I pray pray pray for our strength)(2x)

songs.title: Not by might
songs.lyrics:
(Not by might and not by power (“power”),
But by spirit alone (“ruach!”),
Shall we all live in peace)(2x)

The children sing,
The children dream,
And their tears may fall,
But we'll hear them call,
And (another song will rise)(3x)

(Not by might and not by power (“power”),
But by spirit alone (“ruach!”),
Shall we all live in peace)(2x)

Not by might, not by power, shalom!

songs.title: Ilan Ilan
songs.lyrics:
אִילָן אִילָן, בַּמָּה אֲבָרֶכְךָ?
אִם אוֹמַר לְךָ שֶׁיְּהוּ פֵּירוֹתֶיךָ מְתוּקִין
הֲרֵי פֵּירוֹתֶיךָ מְתוּקִין, שֶׁיְּהֵא צִילְּךָ נָאֶה
הֲרֵי צִילְּךָ נָאֶה, שֶׁתְּהֵא אַמַּת הַמַּיִם עוֹבֶרֶת תַּחְתֶּיךָ
אַף אַתָּה, בַּמָּה אֲבָרֶכְךָ?
אִם בְּתוֹרָה הֲרֵי תּוֹרָה,

אִם בְּעוֹשֶׁר הֲרֵי עוֹשֶׁר,

אִם בְּבָנִים הֲרֵי בָּנִים

(ilan ilan bama avarechecha)(4x)
im omar lecha she'yehu peirotecha metukin
harei (peirotecha)(2x) metukin
she'yeheh (tzilcha)(2x) na'eh
harei tzilcha na'eh
sheteheh (amat)(2x) hamayim overet tachtecha
(ilan ilan bama avarechecha)(4x)
af atah, bama avarechecha
im b'torah harei torah
im b'osher harei osher
im b'vanim harei banim

Tree, tree, with what shall I bless you? If I say to you that your fruits should be sweet, your fruits are already sweet; if I say that your shade should be pleasant, your shade is already pleasant; if I say that a stream of water should flow beneath you, a stream of water already flows beneath you
[Rabbi Nachman.]With what shall I bless you? If I bless you with Torah, you already have Torah; if I bless you with wealth, you already have wealth; if I bless you with children, you already have children.

songs.title: Tzadik katamar
songs.lyrics:
צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה
נַעַר  הָיִיתִי גַּם־זָקַנְתִּי וְלֹא־רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק נֶעֱזָב
אָנֹכִי לַיְיָ אָנֹכִי אָשִׁירָה
אֲזַמֵּר לַיְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל

(tzadik katamar yifrach k'erez bal'vanon yisgeh
tzadik (katamar yifrach)(2x))(2x)
(na'ar hayiti gam zakanti v'lo ra'iti tzadik ne'ezav)(2x)
(tzadik katamar yifrach k'erez bal'vanon yisgeh
tzadik (katamar yifrach)(2x))(2x)
[niggun]

(anochi la'adonai anochi ashirah
azameir la'adonai elohei yisra'eil)(4x)
(tzadik (katamar)(3x) yifrach)(4x)

The righteous bloom like a date-palm;
they thrive like a cedar in Lebanon;
I have been young and am now old,
but I have never seen someone righteous abandoned.
I will sing, will sing to God,
Will hymn the eternal, the God of Israel.

songs.title: Adama v'shamayim
songs.lyrics:
אֲדָמָה וְשָׁמַיִם, חֹם הָאֵשׁ, צְלִיל הַמַּיִם
אֲנִי מַרְגִּישׁ זֹאת בְּגוּפִי, בְּרוּחִי, בְּנִשְׁמָתִי

(adamah v'shamayim, chom ha'eish, tz'lil hamayim
ani margish zot b'gufi, b'ruchi, b'nishmati)(2x)

Earth and Sky, the heat of fire, the sound of water
I feel it in my body, in my spirit, in my soul.

((heya)(7x) ho)(2x)
(heya)(4x)
(heya)(3x) ho)(2x)

Mother earth, Father sky, heat of fire, drop of water
I can feel it in my body, in my spirit and in my soul

songs.title: Mother was the earth
songs.lyrics:
If the thunder was your son
And your daughter was the sky
If the waters in the river
Were your brothers rushin' by
If your daddy was a valley
Where the wild flowers grow
And the mountains in the distance
Were your sisters capped with snow

CHORUS:
Would we see
This is our family
Would we know
Their Godly worth
And their blessings
All from Heaven
If our mother was the earth

If those trees are standing tall
Because Grandad's at the roots
If the ocean tides keep rollin'
All because of Grandma moon
If that burning light above
Was a child lookin' down
Digging into soil
To help grow the fertile ground

CHORUS

(CHORUS 2x speed)(2x)

If we listen for the ancients
In their storm clouds' lullaby
And we hear the call of children
In a coyote's plaintive cry

(CHORUS 2x speed)(2x)

CHORUS

songs.title: Stand up
songs.lyrics:
(We stand on the earth so we better
Stand for her together)(2x)
