(Stand up for our mother
Stand up for each other)(2x)

(We were put in this paradise
It's our job to guard her life)(2x)

CHORUS

BRIDGE:

לְעׇבְדָהּ וּלְשׇׁמְרָהּ

(l'ovdah ulshamrah)(2x)

To serve and to guard

CHORUS

(CHORUS(2x))/BRIDGE

songs.title: My roots go down
songs.lyrics:
(My roots go down, down to the earth)(3x)
My roots go down
(My trunk stands strong, strong in the wind)(3x)
My trunk stands strong

(My branches reach, reach for the sky)(3x)
My branches reach
(My leaves they turn, turn to the light)(3x)
My leaves they turn

(My fruits I give, give from my heart)(3x)
My fruits I give
(My seeds they bring forth new life)(3x)
My seeds they bring

שׁוֹרָשַׁי עֲמוּקִים בָּאֲדָמָה

(shorashay amukim ba'adamah)(3x)
ba'adamah))(2x)

I will plant my roots in the earth

songs.title: The Leaf
songs.lyrics:
כַּמָּה יַעֲלֶה עָלֶה
אִם הֶעָלִים יֵעָלְמוּ
כַּמָּה יַעֲלֶה עָלֶה

כַּמָּה יַעֲלֶה עָלֶה
אִם מֵהָעוֹלָם בַּעֲלֵי חַיִּים יֵעָלְמוּ
כַּמָּה יַעֲלֶה הֶעָלֶה

kamah ya'aleh aleh
im he'alim ye'almu
kamah ya'aleh aleh
kamah ya'aleh aleh
im meha'olam ba'alei chayim ye'almu
kamah ya'aleh he'aleh

How much will a leaf cost
If the leaves disappear
How much will a leaf cost
How much will a leaf cost
If living beings disappear from the world
How much will the leaf cost

songs.title: Hanukah hanukah
songs.lyrics:
Hanuka, Hanuka
Ocho diyas di felisita;
Lai, lai…

Ocho diyas di kantar;
Ocho diyas di bailyar;
Ocho diyas di guzar;

Hanuka, Hanuka
Eight days of happiness.
Eight days of singing.
Eight days of dancing.
Eight days of enjoying.

songs.title: Vashti
songs.lyrics:
וַשְׁתִּי וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה תַּתְחִיל מֶרֶד בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה
אִם אִשָּׁה פָּגְעָה בִּכְבוֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ לְעֵינֵיכֶם, יָבִיא הַדָּבָר לַהַרֹס מַלְכוּתֶךָ לָעוֹלָם כּוּלוֹ
וַתְּמָאֵן הַמַּלְכָּה וַשְׁתִּי לָבוֹא בִּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ, וַיִּכְצֹף הַמֶּלֶךְ
מְאֹד וַחֲמָתוֹ בָּעֲרָה בוֹ

(vashti vashti hamalkah tat'chil mered b'shushan habirah)(2x)
im ishah pag'ah bich'vod hamelech l'eineichem
yavi hadavar laharos malchutecha la'olam kulo
(vashti vashti hamalkah tat'chil mered b'shushan habirah)(2x)
vat'ma'en hamalkah vashti lavo bidvar hamelech
vayich'tzof hamelech m'od vachamato ba'arah vo

Vashti, Vashti, the Queen will start rebellion in Shushan, the capital
If the wife disrespected the king in front of all the people; it could cause the downfall of your kingdom forever.
Queen Vashti refused to appear before the king;
The king was very wrathful, and his anger burned within him.

songs.title: Ish y'hudi
songs.lyrics:
אִישׁ יְהוּדִי הָיָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וּשְׁמוֹ מׇרְדֳּכַי
בֶּן יָאִיר בֶּן־שִׁמְעִי בֶּן־קִישׁ אִישׁ יְמִינִי

((ish y'hudi hayah b'shushan habirah)(3x)
ushmo mordochai)(2x)
ben ya'ir ben shimi ben kish ish yemini
ben ya'ir ben shimi ushmo mordochai

In the fortress Shushan lived a Jew by the name of Mordechai, son of Jair son of Shimei son of Kish, a Benjaminite.

songs.title: Tshuatam
songs.lyrics:
תְּשׁוּעָתָם הָיִיתָ לָנֶצַח
וְתִקְוָתָם בְּכָל דוֹר וָדוֹר

(tshuatam hayita lanetzach
v'tikvatam b'chol dor vador)(2x)
(v'tikvatam b'chol dor vador)(4x)

Your salvation will be victorious,
and your hope will be in every generation.

songs.title: Utzu eitzah
songs.lyrics:
עֻצוּ עֵצָה, וְתֻפָר
דַּבְּרוּ דָבָר וְלֹא יָקוּם
כִּי עִמָּנוּ אֵל

(utzu eitzah v'tufar
dabru davar v'lo yakum)(2x)
dabru davar v'lo yakum
(ki imanu el)(4x)
[niggun]

They have devised schemes, but they have been foiled; they have made declarations against us, but they have not been fulfilled, because God is with us!

songs.title: Mah navu alei
songs.lyrics:
מַה נָּאווּ עֲלֵי הֶהָרִים רַגְלֵי
מְבַשֵּׂר שָׁלוֹם בְּבִנְיַן עִירֵךְ
קוֹל צוֹפַיִךְ יִשְׂאוּ קוֹל רִנָּה
הִתְנַעֲרִי מִתּוֹךְ מְגִנָּה
עַיִן בְּעַיִן תִּרְאִי שְׁכִינָה
וְשָׁבוּ בָנַיִךְ לִגְבוּלֵךְ

(mah navu alei heharim raglei
m'vaseir shalom b'vinyan ireich)(2x)
kol tzofayich yis'u kol rinah
hitna'ari mitoch m'ginah
ayin b'ayin tir'i shechinah
v'shavu vanayich ligvuleich

How pleasant atop the mountains are the footsteps
of the messenger bearing tidings of peace in your city
The voices of your watchmen will rise up in joy
shake off your sorrow
Your eyes shall behold the Shekhinah
and your sons shall return to your borders

לִשְׁבוּיִים דְּרוֹר בְּשִׁיר וּמִזְמוֹר
אֶל בֵּית הַר הַמּוֹר יְהִי שְׁבִילֵךְ
סֹלוּ סֹלוּ אֶת הַמְּסִלָּה
פִּצְחוּ רְנָנָה וּתְהִלָּה
יָבֺא מְבַשֵּׂר בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ מִלָּה
קוּמִי עוּרִי כִּי בָא אוֹרֵךְ

mah navu alei heharim raglei
m'vaseir shalom b'vinyan ireich
lishvuyim d'ror b'shir umizmor
el beit har hamor y'hi sh'vileich
solu solu et ham'silah
pitzchu r'nanah ut'hilah
yavo m'vaseir bilshono milah
kumi uri ki va'oreich

Freedom to the captives in song and melody
to the Temple may your path lead
Pave pave the pathway
break forth in delight and glory
A messenger will come with a word on his tongue
Arise and shine for your light has come

צְאִי מִבָּבֶל קִרְיַת עוֹבְדֵי בֵל
כִּנּוֹר וָנֵבֶל אָז יְהִי שִׁירֵךְ
שׂוֹשׂ יָשִׂישׂוּ כָּל אֲבֵלֵי צִיּוֹן
לָבֺא לַחֲסוֹת בְּצֵל הָעֶלְיוֹן
בָּנֺה אֶבְנֶה לָךְ נְוֵה אַפִּרְיוֹן
אָכִין כִּסֵּא לְדָוִד מַלְכֵּךְ

mah navu alei heharim raglei
m'vaseir shalom b'vinyan ireich
tz'i mibavel kiryat ovdei veil
kinor vaneivel az y'hi shireich
sos yasisu kol aveilei tziyon
lavo lachasot b'tzeil ha'elyon
banoh evneh lach n'veih apir'yon
achin kisei l'david malkeich

Leave Babylon where they worship Bel
the harp and lyre will accompany your song
Greatly rejoice all mourners in Ẓion
come take refuge in the shadow of the Most High
I shall build for you a magnificent palace
I shall set a throne for your king, David

שְׂאִי עֵינַיִךְ וּרְאִי בָנַיִךְ
בָּאוּ אֵלַיִךְ לָאוֹר בְּאוֹרֵךְ
תַּחַת חֹשֶׁךְ אָשִׂים לָךְ אוֹרָה
אָז מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא הַתּוֹרָה
הִנֵּה גָדוֹל הוּא אָיֺם וְנוֹרָא
בְּיוֹם שִׂימִי כֶתֶר לְרֺאשֵׁךְ

mah navu alei heharim raglei
m'vaseir shalom b'vinyan ireich
s'i einayich ur'i banayich
ba'u eilayich la'or b'oreich
tachat choshech asim lach orah
az mitziyon teitzei hatorah
hinei gadol hu ayom v'norah
b'yom simi cheter l'rosheich

Lift your eyes and see your children
they have come to you, to the light in your light
In place of darkness I will give you light
then from Tsiyon Torah shall come forth
For it will be great and aweful
on the day you shall place a crown upon your head

עַד מָתַי כַּלָּה יָפָה וּמְעֻלָּה
לְזָּר בְּעוּלָה כְּדַל וָהֵלֶךְ
עוּרִי עוּרִי עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל
אָחִישׁ אֶשְׁלַח יִנּוֹן וְגוֹאֵל
וְגַם אָקִים לָךְ חוֹמַת אֲרִיאֵל
זָכֹר אֶזְכֹּר חֶסֶד נְעוּרֵךְ

mah navu alei heharim raglei
m'vaseir shalom b'vinyan ireich
ad matai kalah yafah um'ulah
l'zar b'ulah k'dal vaheilech
uri uri adat yisra'eil
achish eshlach yinon v'go'eil
v'gam akim lach chomat ari'eil
zachor ezkor chesed n'ureich

Till when beautiful and wonderful bride
will you espouse a stranger like a vagabond
Awake awake people of Israel
I will hasten and send Yinon and a redeemer
And I will raise for you the walls of Ariel
I will remember the devotion of your youth

[niggun]

songs.title: Shoshanat ya'akov
songs.lyrics:
וּמׇרְדֳּכַי יָצָא  מִלִּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ
בִּלְבוּשׁ מַלְכוּת וַעֲטֶרֶת זָהָב וְהָעִיר שׁוּשָׁן צָהֲלָה וְשָׂמֵחָה
לַיְּהוּדִים הָיְתָה אוֹרָה וְשִׂמְחָה וְשָׂשֹׂן וִיקָר
שׁוֹשַׁנַּת יַעֲקֹב צָהֲלָה וְשָׂמֵחָה בִּרְאוֹתָם יַחַד תְּכֵלֶת מָרְדְּכַי

(u'mordochai yatza milifnei hamelech
bilvush malchut va'ateret zahav
u'mordochai yatza milifnei hamelech
v'ha'ir shushan tzahalah v'samechah
(lay'hudim haitah (orah v'simchah)(2x) v'sason vikar)(2x))(2x)

(shoshanat ya'akov tzahala)(2x) v'samechah
(birotam yachad t'chelet mordochai)(2x)

Mordechai left the king's presence in royal robes with a magnificent crown of gold, and the city of Shushan rang with joyous cries.
The Jews enjoyed light and gladness,
happiness and honor.
The rose of Jacob thrilled with joy when they beheld Mordechai garbed in royal blue.

songs.title: Kol kovecha
songs.lyrics:
כָּל קֹוֶיךָ לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ. וְלֹא יִכָּלְמוּ לָנֶצַח

kol kovecha lo yeivoshu v'lo yikalmu lanetzach

All your hopes will not be dashed and will not be defeated.

songs.title: Orah v’simchah
songs.lyrics:
לַיְּהוּדִים הָיְתָה אוֹרָה וְשִׂמְחָה
וְשָׂשׂוֹן וִיקָר כֵּן תִּהְיֶה לָּֽנוּ

(lay'hudim haytah (orah v'simchah)(2x)
v'sason vikar)(4x)
[niggun]
(kein tihyeh lanu)(2x)
orah v'simchah v'sason vikar
[niggun]
orah v'simchah v'sason vikar

The Jews enjoyed light and gladness, happiness and honor. So may it be for us.

songs.title: Madame Gashpar
songs.lyrics:
Madame Gashpar saliyo al charshi;
Kun il dinaro di Purim
Un poyiko me merki;
Il poyiko Biri-biri-bi.
Si savej la mi sinyora
I pur kuanto lo merki?

Madame Gashpar went to the market;
With the Purim money
I bought myself a little chick
It chirps Biri-biri-bi.
Guess, my lady,
How much did I pay for it?
Madame Gashpar saliyo al charshi;
Madame Gashpar went to the market;

Kun il dinaro di Purim
Una gayinika me merki;
La gayenika Gi-gi-gi:
Il poyiko Biri-biri-bi.
Si savej la mi sinyora
I pur kuanto lo merki?

With the Purim money
I bought myself a little hen;
It clucks Gi-gi-gi;
The chick chirps Biri-biri-bi.
The little rooster: Giri-giri-gi.
The little cow: Mu-mu-mu.
The little bird: Tvi-tvi-tvi.

Madame Gashpar saliyo al charshi;
Kun il dinaro di Purim
Un gayiko me merki;
Il gayiko Giri-giri-gi;
La gayinika Gi-gi-gi;
Il poyiko Biri-biri-bi.
Si savej la mi sinyora
I pur kuanto lo merki?

La vakita Mu-mu-mu;
Il gayiko Giri-giri-gi;
La gayinika Gi-gi-gi;
Il poyiko Biri-biri-bi.
Si savej…

La vakita Mu-mu-mu;
Il gayiko Giri-giri-gi;
La gayinika Gi-gi-gi;
Il poyiko Biri-biri-bi.
Un pashariko Tvi-tvi-tvi;
Si savej…

songs.title: We rise
songs.lyrics:
We rise, humbly hearted
Rise, won't be divided
Rise, with spirit to guide us
Rise!

(In hope, in prayer, we find ourselves here
In hope, in prayer, we're right here)(2x)

And, we rise, all of the children
Rise, elders with wisdom
Rise, ancestors surround us
Rise!

(In hope, in prayer, we find ourselves here
In hope, in prayer, we're right here)(2x)

And, we rise, up from the wreckage
Rise, with tears and with courage
Rise, fighting for life
We rise!

(In hope, in prayer, we find ourselves here
In hope, in prayer, we're right here)(2x)

songs.title: I remember
songs.lyrics:
זָכַרְתִּי לָךְ חֶסֶד נְעוּרַיִךְ אַהֲבַת כְּלוּלֹתָיִךְ

(zacharti lach chesed n'urayich ahavat k'lulotayich)(2x)

I remember your youthful devotion; your love as a bride.

I remember your love and your kindness
When you walked with me through desert wildness
((I remember)(7x) you)(2x)

לֶכְתֵּךְ אַחֲרַי בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא זְרוּעָה

(lechteich (acharai)(2x) bamidbar
lechteich acharai b'eretz lo zru'a)(2x)

You followed me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.

How you (walked with me)(3x)
How you walked with me when you were young and free
How you (walked with me)(3x)
How you walked with me through the sand and sea
((I remember)(7x) you)(2x)

songs.title: Vatikach miriam
songs.lyrics:
וַתִּקַּח מִרְיָם הַנְּבִיאָה אֲחוֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת־הַתֹּף בְּיָדָהּ
וַתֵּצֶאןָ כׇל־הַנָּשִׁים אַחֲרֶיהָ בְּתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלֹת
וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלְכוּ בַיַּבָּשָׁה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם

(vatikach miriam han'vi'ah achot aharon et hatof b'yadah)(2x)
(vateitzena chol hanashim achareha b'tupim uvimcholot
vateitzena chol hanashim achareha)(2x)
(uv'nei yisra'eil halchu vayabashah (b'toch hayam)(2x))(2x)

Israelites marched on dry ground in the midst of the sea. Then Miriam the prophet, Aaron's sister, picked up a hand-drum, and all the women went out after her in dance with hand-drums.

songs.title: Miriam's song
songs.lyrics:
CHORUS:
And the women dancing with their timbrels,
Followed Miriam as she sang her song,
Sing a song to the one whom we've exalted,
Miriam and the women danced and danced the whole night long.

And Miriam was a weaver of unique variety
The tapestry she wove was one which sang our history.
With every thread and every strand she crafted her delight!
A woman touched with spirit, she dances toward the light.

CHORUS

When Miriam stood upon the shores and gazed across the sea
The wonder of this miracle she soon came to believe.
Whoever thought the sea would part with an outstretched hand
And we would pass to freedom and march to the promised land!

CHORUS

And Miriam the prophet took her timbrel in her hand,
And all the women followed her just as she had planned,
And Miriam raised her voice in song—
She sang with praise and might
We've just lived through a miracle:
We're going to dance tonight!

CHORUS

songs.title: When you believe
songs.lyrics:
Many nights we've prayed
With no proof anyone could hear
In our hearts a hopeful song
We barely understood
Now, we are not afraid
Although we know there's much to fear
We were moving mountains long before we knew we could

CHORUS:
There can be miracles, when you believe!
Though hope is frail, it's hard to kill
Who knows what miracles, you can achieve
When you believe, somehow you will
You will when you believe!

In this time of fear
When prayer so often proves in vain
Hope seems like the summer birds
Too swiftly, flown away
Yet now I'm standing here
My heart's so full, I can't explain
Seeking faith and speaking words
I never thought I'd say

CHORUS

אָשִׁירָה לַיְיָ כִּי־גָאֹה גָּאָה
מִי־כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְיָ מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ
נָחִיתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ עַם־זוּ גָּאָלְתָּ

((ashirah ladonai ki ga'oh ga'ah)(2x)
(mi chamochah ba'eilim adonai
mi kamochah nedar bakodesh
(nachita v'chasd'cha am zu ga'alta)(2x)
(ashirah)(3x))(2x)

I will sing to God, who has triumphed gloriously.
Who is like you, oh eternal one, among the celestials?
Who is like you, majestic in holiness?
In your love you lead the people you redeemed.

CHORUS

songs.title: Avadim hayinu
songs.lyrics:
עֲבָדִים הָיִינוּ לְפַרְעֹה בְּמִצְרָיִם עַתָּה - בְּנֵי חוֹרִין

avadim (hayinu)(2x) l'faroh (b'mitzrayim)(2x)
avadim hayinu (atah)(2x) b'nei chorin
avadim hayinu (atah)(2x) (b'nei chorin)(2x)

We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt – now we are free.

songs.title: Dayeinu
songs.lyrics:
אִלּוּ הוֹצִיאָנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם, וְלֹא עָשָׂה בָּהֶם שְׁפָטִים,דַּיֵּנוּ
אִלּוּ עָשָׂה בָּהֶם שְׁפָטִים, וְלֹא עָשָׂה בֵּאלֹהֵיהֶם, דַּיֵּנוּ

ilu hotzi'anu mimitzrayim
v'lo asah bahem sh'fatim dayeinu
ilu asah bahem sh'fatim
v'lo asah b'eiloheihem (dayeinu)(9x)

If God had brought us out from Egypt, but not carried out judgments against them, it would have sufficed.
If God had carried out judgments against them, but not against their idols, it would have sufficed.

אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת, וְלֹא קֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי,דַּיֵּנוּ
אִלּוּ קֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי, וְלֹא נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת הַתּוֹרָה, דַּיֵּנוּ

ilu natan lanu et hashabbat
v'lo keirvanu lifnei har sinai dayeinu
ilu keirvanu lifnei har sinai
v'lo natan lanu et hatorah (dayeinu)(9x)

If God had given us the Shabbat, but not brought us before Mount Sinai, it would have sufficed.
If God had brought us before Mount Sinai, but not given us the Torah, it would have sufficed.

אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת הַתּוֹרָה, וְלֹא הִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,דַּיֵּנוּ
אִלּוּ הִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְלֹא בָּנָה לָנוּ אֶת בֵּית
הַמִּקְדָּש, דַּיֵּנוּ

ilu natan lanu et hatorah
v'lo hichnisanu l'eretz yisra'eil dayeinu
ilu hichnisanu l'eretz yisra'eil
v'lo banah lanu et beit hamikdash (dayeinu)(17x)!

If God had given us the Torah, but not brought us into the land of Israel, it would have sufficed.
If God had brought us into the Land of Israel, but not built for us the Holy Temple, it would have sufficed.

songs.title: Ha lachma anya
songs.lyrics:
הָא לַחְמָא עַנְיָא דִּי אֲכָלוּ
אַבְהָתָנָא בְאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
כָּל דִכְפִין יֵיתֵי וְיֵיכֹל
כָּל דִצְרִיךְ יֵיתֵי וְיִפְסַח
הָשַּׁתָּא הָכָא, לְשָׁנָה הַבָּאָה בְּאַרְעָא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל
הָשַּׁתָּא עַבְדֵי, לְשָׁנָה הַבָּאָה בְּנֵי חוֹרִין

ha lachma anya (di achalu)(2x)
avhatana v'ara d'mitzrayim
kol dichfin (yeitei v'yeichol)(2x)
kol ditzrich (yeitei v'yifsach)(2x)
hashata hacha l'shana haba'a b'ara d'yisra'eil
hashata avdei l'shana haba'a b'nei chorin

This is the bread of affliction that our ancestors ate in the land of Egypt. Let all who are hungry come and eat. Let anyone who are in need come and observe Passover. This year we are here; next year in the Land of Israel. This year we are slaves; next year we shall be free.

songs.title: Malei shira
songs.lyrics:
אִלּוּ פִינוּ מָלֵא שִׁירָה כַּיָּם
אֵין אֲנַחְנוּ מַסְפִּיקִים לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ
לְהוֹדוֹת לְהַלֵּל
לְשַׁבֵּחַ לְפָאֵר
לְרוֹמֵם לְהַדֵּר
לְבָרֵךְ לְעַלֵּה

((ilu finu maleh shira kayam)(3x)
maleh (shira)(2x) kayam)(3x)
(ein anachnu maspikim l'hodot l'cha)(3x)
l'hodot l'haleil l'shabei'ach l'fa'eir
l'romeim l'hadeir l'vareich l'aleih

If our mouths were as full of song as the sea…
Still we could not thank you enough.
Thank, praise, glorify, extol, exalt, honor, bless, revere.

songs.title: Ten Plagues of Egypt
songs.lyrics:
First God sent plague number one
Turned the Nile into blood
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number two
Jumping frogs all over you
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number three
Swarms of knats from head to knee
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number four
filthy flies, need we say more
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number five
All the livestock up and died
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number six
Boils and sores to make you sick
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number seven
Hail and lightning down from heaven
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number eight
Locust came and they sure ate
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number nine
Total darkness all the time
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
They told Pharaoh, “Let them go!”

Then God sent plague number ten
Pharaoh’s son died so he gave in
All the people in Egypt were feeling pretty low
Finally Pharaoh let them go.

songs.title: Orah hi
songs.lyrics:
אוֹרָה הִיא

(orah hi)(3x)

CHORUS:

תִבְנֶה בֵיתָה בְּקָרוֹב
בִּמְהֵרַה בְּיָמֵינוּ בְּקָרוֹב אֶלַה בְּנִי בֵיתֵךְ בְּקָרוֹב

tivneh veitah b'karov
(bimheirah)(2x) b'yameinu b'karov
elah b’ni, elah b’ni b’ni veiteich b'karov

בִּינָה הִיא, גִילָה הִיא, דִמְעָה הִיא

binah hi gilah hi dim'ah hi

CHORUS

הַדָר הִיא, וֶרֶד הִיא, זֶרֶם הִיא

hadar hi vered hi zerem hi

CHORUS

חִידוּשׁ הִיא, טִבּוּר הִיא, יִחוּד הִיא

chidush hi tibur hi yichud hi

CHORUS

כֶּסֶא הִיא, לֵידָה הִיא, מַעָיָן הִיא

kese hi leidah hi ma'ayan hi

CHORUS

נְחַמָה הִיא, סְלִיחָה הִיא, עוֹצְמָה הִיא

n'chamah hi s'lichah hi otzmah hi

CHORUS

פִּדְיוֹן הִיא, צֶדֶק הִיא, קוֹדֶשׁ הִיא

pidyon hi tzedek hi kodesh hi

CHORUS

רַעַיָה הִיא, שׁוֹנָה הִיא, תָּמַה הִיא

ra'ayah hi shonah hi tamah hi

She is light, she is light. May she build her house soon, soon, speedily and in our days. God, build your house soon, close to us in time and space.
She is wisdom, she is joy, she is tears.
She is splendor, she is a rose, she is a flowing stream.
She is renewal, she is the center, she is oneness.
She is the full moon, she is birth, she is the fountain-source.
She is comfort, she is forgiveness, she is strength.
She is redemption, she is righteousness, she is holiness.
She is a beloved companion, she is always changing, she is complete and perfect.

songs.title: S'firat ha'omer
songs.lyrics:
לְשֵׁם יִחוּד קּוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
הִנְּנִי מוּכָן וּמְזֻמָּן לְקַיֵּם מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה שֶׁל סְפִירַת הָעֹמֶר
''שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹת תְּמִימוֹת תִּהְיֶינָה''
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם
אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו, וְצִוָּנוּ עַל סְפִירַת הָעֹמֶר

l'sheim yichud kud'sha b'rich hu ushchinteih
hin'ni muchan um'zuman l'kayeim mitzvat aseih
(shel s'firat ha'omer)(4x)
(sheva shabbatot t'mimot tihyenah)(2x)
(shel s'firat ha'omer)(4x)
baruch atah adonai eloheinu melech ha'olam asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav v'tzivanu (al s'firat ha'omer)(4x)

For the sake of the unification of the transcendent creative power with the divine presence dwelling here and now, I am here, I am ready to fulfill the mitzvah of counting the Omer. “...Seven weeks. They must be complete…” Blessed are You, Adonai our God, Ruler of the universe, who sanctifies us with mitzvot, and commands us concerning the counting of the Omer.

songs.title: Esa einai
songs.lyrics:
(I lift my eyes to the mountains.)(3x)
(Where does my help)(3x) come from?

אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי

(esa einai el heharim mei'ayin yavo ezri)(2x)

(esa einai)(4x)

I turn my eyes to the mountains; from where will my help come?

Ending:
(My help comes from Adonai.)(3x)
(That’s where my help)(3x) comes from.

songs.title: Kol han'shamah
songs.lyrics:
כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ

(kol han'shamah t'haleil yah, hal'luyah)(2x)
(hal'luyah)(2x) (aye)(5x) (hal'luyah)(2x)

All spirit and breath praises the Divine, Halleluyah!

songs.title: Od yishama
songs.lyrics:
עוֹד יִשָׁמַע בְּעַרֵי יְהוּדָה
וּבְחוּצוֹת יְרוּשָלַיִם
קוֹל שָשוֹן וְקוֹל שִמְחָה
קוֹל חָתָן וְקוֹל כָּלָה
קוֹל שָשוֹן וְקוֹל שִמְחָה
קוֹל אָהוּב וְקוֹל רֵעָה

(od yishama b'arei y'hudah
uv'chutzot y'rushalayim)(2x)
kol sason v'kol simchah
kol chatan v'kol kalah
kol sason v'kol simchah
kol ahuv v'kol rei'ah

[niggun]

Yet again there shall be heard in the cities of Judah
and in the streets of Jerusalem.
The voice of joy and the voice of gladness
The voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride
The voice of the lover and the voice of the friend

songs.title: May I be empty
songs.lyrics:
May I be empty and open to receive the light
May I be empty and open to receive
May I be full and open to receive the light
May I be full and open to receive

songs.title: Receiving the word
songs.lyrics:
בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָתַן־לָמוֹ

(b'amud anan y'dabeir aleihem)(4x)
(shamru eidotav (v'chok natan lamo)(2x))(2x)

God spoke to them in a pillar of cloud; they obeyed those decrees, the law given to them.

songs.title: And you shall love
songs.lyrics:
וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ
אִם לֹא עַכְשָׁיו, אֵימָתָי
בְּכׇל לְבָבְךָ נַפְשְׁךָ מְאֹדֶךָ, וְאָהַבְתָּ

(v'ahavta l'rei'acha kamocha)(2x)
(im lo ach'shav eimatai)(4x)
(b'chol l'vavcha v'nafsh'cha m'odecha v'ahavta)(2x)

Love your fellow as yourself.
And if not now, when?
With all your heart, soul, and might, you must love.

songs.title: T'filat haderech
songs.lyrics:
יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְפָנֶיךָ
יי אֱלֹהֵינוּ
יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנַיִךְ
אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ

y'hi ratzon milfanecha
adonai eloheinu
y'hi ratzon milfanayich
elohei avoteinu v'imoteinu

May it be Your will, our God and God of our ancestors

שֶׁתּוֹלִיכֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם
וְתַצְעִידֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם
וְתַדְרִיכֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם
וְתִסְמְכֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם

shetolicheinu l'shalom
v'tatz'ideinu l'shalom
v'tadricheinu l'shalom
v'tism'cheinu l'shalom

that You lead us in peace and help us reach our destination safely, joyfully, and peacefully.

וְתַגִּיעֵנוּ לִמְחוֹז חֶפְצֵנוּ לְחַיִּים
וּלְשִׂמְחָה וּלְשָׁלוֹם
וְתַצִּילֵנוּ מִכַּף כָּל אוֹיֵב וְאוֹרֵב
וְלִסְטִים וְחַיּוֹת רָעוֹת בַּדֶּרֶךְ

v'tagi'einu limchoz cheftzeinu l'chayim
ul'simcha ul'shalom
v'tatzileinu mikaf kol oyeiv v'oreiv
v'listim v'chayot ra'ot baderech

May You protect us on our leaving and on our return,
and rescue us from any harm.

songs.title: Where you go
songs.lyrics:
(Where you go, I will go (Beloved)/(Biome)/(Children)
Where you go, I will go)(2x)
And (where you lie, I will lie (Beloved)/(Biome)/(Children)
Where you lie, I will lie)(2x)
And your people are my people
Your people are mine
Your people are my people
Your Divine my Divine
songs.notes: Changed the repeating verses to be shorter

songs.title: Wherever you go
songs.lyrics:
כִּי אֶל־אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכִי אֵלֵךְ
וּבַאֲשֶׁר תָּלִינִי אָלִין
עַמֵּךְ עַמִּי
וֵאלֹהַיִךְ אֱלֹהָי
בַּאֲשֶׁר תָּמוּתִי אָמוּת

ki el asher teilchi eileich
uva'asher talini alin
ameich ami
veilohayich elohai
ba'asher tamuti amut

For wherever you go, I will go; wherever you lodge, I will lodge; your people shall be my people, and your God my God. Where you die, I will die

On a dusty open road to her homeland in the west
Naomi could not hold all the tears that she had left.
As she stood before her journey, she said goodbye to Ruth
Go on to your family, may God always bless you
But Ruth would never leave her, Naomi was her home
she said as she held her, “you're the family I know”

CHORUS:
Wherever you go, I will go there too.
Where you live, I'll live.
Your people will be mine,
Your god will be my god
And where you rest I'll lie.

Through the barren land beneath the desert flame
The strength found in each other was a providential rain
And it brought them to the Jordan where they waded through the tides
Over hills that followed to a promised land they climbed.

CHORUS

Along the path between them, the covenant was sown
A bond that gave Ruth freedom in the family she chose.

CHORUS

songs.title: Va'ani Ashir Uzecha
songs.lyrics:
וַאָנִי אָשִׁיר עֻזֶךָ
וַאֲרַנֵן לַבֹּקֶר חֲסְדֶּךָ
כִּי הָיִיתָ מִשְׂגָּב לִי
וּמָנוֹס בְּיוֹם צַר לִי

עֻזִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה

(va'ani ashir uzecha
va'aranein labokeir chasdecha
ki hayita misgav li
u'manos l'yom tzar li)(2x)
(uzi eilecha (azameirah)(2x))(4x)

But I will sing your strength
Extol each morning your lovingkindness
For you have been my haven
And my refuge in my time of trouble
To you, Oh my strength, I will sing

songs.title: Nasu
songs.lyrics:
נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְיָ. נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם
נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְיָ. יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם
מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי יָם
מִקּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְיָ
עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֱמְנוּ מְאֹד
לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה קֹדֶשׂ, יְיָ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים

nasu n'harot adonai nasu n'harot kolam
nasu n'harot adonai yisu n'harot dochyam
mikolot mayim rabim adirim mishb'rei yam
mikolot mayim rabim adir bamarom adonai
[niggun]
eidotecha ne'emnu m'od
l'veitcha na'avah kodesh
adonai l'orech yamim
[niggun]

The ocean sounds, Holy One,
The ocean sounds its thunder,
The ocean sounds its pounding.
And above the thunder of the mighty waters,
more majestic than the breakers of the sea
is the Holy One, majestic on high,
If only you can hear the sound.
Your wisdom and teachings continue to endure;
It’s beautiful and grand, to come into Your holy house,
Holy One, for all times.

songs.title: Nachamu
songs.lyrics:
נַחֲמוּ נַחֲמוּ עַמִּי יֹאמַר אֱלֹהֵיכֶם

((nachamu)(2x) ami yomar eloheichem)(4x)

Comfort, oh comfort My people, says your God.

(Comfort us)(2x) in our wilderness
Comfort us as we struggle to take care of one another
(Comfort us)(2x) in our wilderness
Comfort us as we struggle with this world

songs.title: Waters of Babylon
songs.lyrics:
By the waters of Babylon
We laid our lyres down
Laid our lyres down,
Sat and cried
By the waters of Babylon
We sang no sacred songs
Sang no sacred songs,
Our tongues were tied

[niggun]

If I forget you Jerusalem
I'll play no more again
Play no more again,
Not one more time
Won't you show me Jerusalem
Razed and broken
Razed and broken,
Alone on high

[niggun]

By the waters of Babylon
We laid our lyres down
Laid our lyres down,
For a long long time

[niggun]

songs.title: Those who sow
songs.lyrics:
(Those who sow, who sow in tears, (will reap in joy)(2x)
Those who sow, who sow in tears, (will reap)(2x) in joy)(2x)

It's the song of the dreamer
From the dark place it grows
Like a flower in the desert
The oasis of our souls
Come back, come back where we belong
You who hear our longing (sighs)/(cries)
Our mouths, our lips are filled with song
You can see our tear-filled eyes!

songs.title: Hazorim b'dimah
songs.lyrics:
הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹרוּ

((hazorim b'dimah b'rinah yiktzoru)(x3)

(Those who plant in tears, will reap in joy)(2x))(2x)

הָלוֹךְ יֵלֵךְ  וּבָכֹה נֹשֵׂא מֶשֶׁךְ־הַזָּרַע
בֹּא־יָבֹא בְרִנָּה נֹשֵׂא אֲלֻמֹּתָיו

haloch yeileich u'vachoh
nosei meshech ha'zara
bo yavo v'rinah nosei alumotav

One who goes along weeping,
carrying the seed-bag,
shall come back with songs of joy,
carrying the sheaves.

songs.title: Kumi
songs.lyrics:
קוּמִי צְאִי מִתּוךְ הַהֲפֵכָה
רַב לָךְ שֶׁבֶת בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא
וְהוּא יַחֲמוֹל עָלַיִךְ חֶמְלָה

קוּמִי רֹנִּי בַלַּיְלָה
לְרֹאשׁ אַשְׁמֻרוֹת
שִׁפְכִי כַמַּיִם לִבֵּךְ
נֹכַח פְּנֵי יְיָ

קוּמִי לְכִי רַעְיָתִי
יָפָתִי וּלְכִי־לָךְ
כִּי־הִנֵּה הַסְּתָיו עָבָר
הַנִּצָּנִים נִרְאוּ בָאָרֶץ
עֵת הַזָּמִיר הִגִּיעַ
וְקוֹל הַתּוֹר
נִשְׁמַע בְּאַרְצֵנוּ

kumi tz'i mitoch hahafeichah
rav lach shevet b'eimek habachah
v’hu yachamol alayich chemlah

kumi roni valaylah
l’rosh ashmurot
shifchi chamayim libeich
nochach p'nei adonai

kumi l'chi rayati
yafati ul’chi lach
ki hinei hastav avar
hanitzanim niru va'aretz
eit hazamir higia
v'kol hator
nishma b'artzeinu

songs.title: Shomreini
songs.lyrics:
שׇׁמְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁוֹן בַּת־עָיִן בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנִי

((shomreini)(3x) k'ishon bat ayin)(4x)
(b'tzeil k'nafecha tastireini)(4x)

Guard me like the apple of Your eye;
hide me in the shadow of Your wings

songs.title: Job’s daughters
songs.lyrics:
יְיָ נָתַן וַיְיָ לָקָח יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ

adonai natan
va'adonai lakach
y'hi sheim adonai m'vorach

God has given;
God has taken;
Bless God’s name.

songs.title: Broken hearted
songs.lyrics:
הָרֹפֵא לִשְׁבוּרֵי לֵב וּמְחַבֵּשׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָם׃
מוֹנֶה מִסְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִים לְכֻלָּם שֵׁמוֹת יִקְרָא׃
הַלְלוּ יָהּ

(harofei lishvurei lev
umchabesh le'atzvotam
moneh mispar lakochavim
lechulam sheimot yikra)(2x)
(hal'lu yah)(4x)

Who heals the broken hearted
and binds their wounds
Who counted the stars
and gave each its name.

(Healer of the broken-hearted
Binder of (their)/(our) wounds
Counter of uncountable stars
You know (where they are)/(who we are))(2x)
(hal'lu yah)(4x)

songs.title: Gam ki eilech
songs.lyrics:
גַּם כִּי־אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת לֹא־אִירָא רָע כִּי־אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
אַךְ  טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי כׇּל־יְמֵי חַיָּי

(gam ki eilech b'gei tzalmavet lo ira ra
ki atah imadi)(x4)
(ki atah imadi)(x5)
(ach (tov)(2x) vachesed)(3x) (yird'funi)(3x)
(kol y'mei chayai)(4x)

Though I walk through a valley of deepest darkness,
I fear no harm, for You are with me.
Only goodness and steadfast love shall pursue me
all the days of my life.

songs.title: I'm not alone
songs.lyrics:
I'm not alone (8x)

I forgot, for a minute
Who I belong to
The mama earth
the wind and rain
The beauty and the pain

I'm not alone
For me the world was created
I'm not alone
To dust I will return

songs.title: Rubies
songs.lyrics:
Like a merchant ship, strong and wide
Gold and oranges, deep inside
More than rubies
More than pearls
The one I love

With purple silk, and tapestry
she weaves a blanket, to cover me
More than rubies
More than pearls
The one I love
The world is woven through us
and I cannot forget
how her fingers hold the thread

She buys a field, she plants a vine
Come the autumn, she makes the wine
More than rubies
More than pearls
The one I love
The world is woven through us
and I cannot forget
how her fingers hold the thread

Let it rain, oh let it storm
She keeps her babies, safe and warm
More than rubies
More than pearls
The one I love

Grace can lie, and beauty's vain
Oh but she calls me, by my name
More than rubies
More than pearls
The one I love
The world is woven through us
I swear I won't forget
how her fingers hold the thread

songs.title: We are loved
songs.lyrics:
We are embraced by arms that find us,
even when we are hidden from ourselves.
We are touched by fingers that soothe us,
even when we are too proud for soothing.
We are counseled by voices that guide us,
even when we are too embittered to hear.

(We are (loved)(3x) by unending love, an unending love)(2x)

We are supported by hands that uplift us,
even in the midst of a fall.
We are urged on by eyes that meet us,
even when we are too weak for meeting.

(We are (loved)(3x) by unending love, an unending love)(2x)

Embraced, touched, soothed, and counseled,
ours are the arms, the fingers, the voices;
ours are the hands, the eyes, the smiles.
We are loved by an unending love.

(We are (loved)(3x) by unending love, an unending love)(2x)

songs.title: Ki tovim
songs.lyrics:
כִּי־טוֹבִים דֹּדֶיךָ מִיָּיִן
יִשָּׁקֵנִי מִנְּשִׁיקוֹת פִּיהוּ

(ki tovim dodecha miyayin (yai dai dai…))(4x)
((yishakeini)(2x) min'shikot pihu)(2x)

Give me kisses of your mouth.
For your love is more delightful than wine.

songs.title: Erev shel shoshanim
songs.lyrics:
עֶרֶב שֶׁל שׁוֹשַׁנִּים,
נֵצֵא נָא אֶל הַבֻּסְתָּן.
מוֹר, בְּשָׂמִים, וּלְבוֹנָה
לְרַגְלֵךְ מִפְתָּן.

erev shel shoshanim,
netzeh na el ha-bustan
mor b'samim u'levona
l'raglech miftan

Evening of roses. Let's go out to the grove.
Myrrh, spices, and incense are a carpet to walk on.

לַיְלָה יוֹרֵד לְאַט,
וְרוּּחַ שׁוֹשָׁן נוֹשְׁבָה.
הָבָה אֶלְחַשׁ לָךְ שִׁיר בַּלָּאט,
זֶמֶר שֶׁל אַהֲבָה.

laila yored le'at
v'ruach shoshan noshvah
havah elchash lach shir balat
zemer shel ahavah

The night comes slowly; a breeze of roses blows
Let me whisper a song to you quietly; a song of love.

שַׁחַר הוֹמָה יוֹנָה
רֹאשֵׁךְ מָלֵא טְלָלִים.
פִּיךְ אֶל הַבֹּקֶר שׁוֹשַׁנָּה,
אֶקְטְפֶנּוּ לִי.

shachar homa yonah
roshech maleih t'lalim
pich el haboker shoshana
ekt'fenu li

At dawn, a dove is cooing; your hair is filled with dew
Your lips to the morning are like a rose. I'll pick it for myself.

songs.title: Dodi li
songs.lyrics:
דֹּוּדִי לִי וַאֲנִי לוֹ הָרֹעֶה בַּשׁוֹשַׁנִּים.

A

(dodi li va'ani lo haro'eh bashoshanim
dodi li va'ani lo haro'eh bashoshanim)(2x)
B

(dodi li va'ani lo, dodi li va'ani lo)(2x)
(dodi li va'ani lo)(2x) (dodi li va'ani lo)(2x)
C

(dodi li dodi li)(2x)

(dodi li va'ani lo, dodi li va'ani lo)(2x)

(dodi li va'ani lo)(2x) (dodi li va'ani lo)(2x)

ABABC

My beloved is mine and I am his, who browses among the lilies.

songs.title: Ani l'dodi
songs.lyrics:
אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי וְדוֹדִי לִי הָרֹעֶה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים

(ani l'dodi v'dodi li haro'eh bashoshanim
(haro'eh)(3x) bashoshanim)(2x)
(ani (l'dodi)(2x) v'dodi li (haro'eh)(2x) bashoshanim)(2x)

I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine;
He browses among the lilies.

songs.title: Mi zot
songs.lyrics:
מִי זֹאת עוֹלָה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּר
מְקוּטֶּרֶת מֹר וּלְבוֹנָה
כְּתִמְרוֹת עָשָׁן
נִישֵׂאת בָּאֲפִרְיוֹן
מֵעֲצֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן
מֶרְכָּבוֹ אַרְגָּמָן
וְתוֹכוֹ רָצוּף אַהֲבָה
מִי זֹאת זֹאת אַהֲבָתִי יוֹנָתִי תַּמָּתִי
זֹאת הִיא שֶׁאָהֱבָה נַפְשִׁי
מִי זֹאת עוֹלָה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּר
כְּמוֹ שַׁחַר נִשְׁקָפָה
כַּחַמָּה בְּרָה תַּמָּה
צָפוֹן פְּאֵר רֹאשָׁהּ
הַלְּבָנָה נִזְרָה
מַרְהִיבָה כַּנִּדְגָּלוֹת
כּוֹכְבֵי מָרוֹם רְצוּפָה
מִי זֹאת זֹאת אַהֲבָתִי יוֹנָתִי תַּמָּתִי
זֹאת הִיא שֶׁאָהֱבָה נַפְשִׁי
מִי זֹאת עוֹלָה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּר
מִתְרַפֶּקֶת עַל דּוֹדָהּ
בְּגַעְגּוּעַ יָשָׁן
שָׁם תַּחַת עֵץ הַתַּפּוּחַ
עוֹרַרְתִּיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה
מִי זֹאת זֹאת אַהֲבָתִי יוֹנָתִי תַּמָּתִי

זֹאת הִיא שֶׁאָהֱבָה נַפְשִׁי

mi zot olah min hamidbar
m'kuteret mor ul'vonah
k'timrot ashan
niseit ba'apiryon
mei'atzei hal'vanon
merkavo argaman
v'tocho ratzuf ahavah

(mi zot zot ahavati
yonati tamati)(3x)
zot hi she'ahavah nafshi

mi zot olah min hamidbar
k'mo shachar nishkafah
kachamah b'rah tamah
tzafon p'eir roshah
hal'vanah nizrah
marhivah kanidgalot
kochvei marom r'tzufah

(mi zot zot ahavati
yonati tamati)(3x)
zot hi she'ahavah nafshi

mi zot olah min hamidbar
mitrapeket al dodah
b'gagu'a yashan
sham tachat eitz hatapu'ach
orarticha b'ahavah
ahavah

(mi zot zot ahavati
yonati tamati)(3x)
zot hi she'ahavah nafshi

Who is this rising from the desert,
Perfumed with myrrh and frankincense,
Like columns of smoke, carried in a royal carriage.
Made from the trees of Lebanon,
Its covering dyed in purple, its interior lined with love.
Who is this?
This is my beloved, my dove, my complete one,
She is the one my soul has loved.
Who is this rising from the desert,
Shining like the dawn,
Radiant as the sun, pure and bright,
The splendor of her crown hidden,
he moon encircled around her,
Awesome as a bannered host,
dorned with stars of heaven.
Who is this?
This is my beloved, my dove, my complete one,
She is the one my soul has loved.
Who is this rising from the desert,
Leaning upon her beloved, in an ancient longing,
There beneath the apple tree, I awakened you with love.
Who is this?
This is my beloved, my dove, my perfect one,
She is the one my soul has loved.

songs.title: Libavtini
songs.lyrics:
לִבַּבְתִּנִי אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה לִבַּבְתִּנִי
בְּאַחַת מֵעֵינַיִךְ בְּאַחַד עֲנָק מִצַּוְּרֹנָיִךְ
מַה־יָּפוּ

libavtini achoti kallah libavtini
be'echat me'einayich, be'echad anak mi'tzav'ronayich
(mah yafu)(2x)

You have captured my heart,
My own, my bride,
You have captured my heart
With one glance of your eyes,
With one coil of your necklace.
How sweet is your love.

songs.title: Berov Chasdecha
songs.lyrics:
וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶךָ

va'ani b'rov chasd'cha avo beitecha

By your abundant grace, I enter your house.

songs.title: River so wide
songs.lyrics:
I went down to the river so wide
Satan was standing on the other side
He said to me
Look and see

I saw you with our only child
With a knife in your hand and your eyes so wild
On the mountaintop
And then the vision stopped.

My love my love what have you done
And where have you taken my only son
Some terrible place
Where I can't see his face

All these years I've been a faithful wife
And I gave you a child so late in my life
My time was done
When I bore you a son

So take me home
And put me to bed
Cause the sun is in the sky
But it is dark inside my head

And I don't' care
If I never do wake up
If I can't be
With the one I love

I went down to the river so wide
Satan was standing on the other side
He said to me
Look and see

But hush little baby, don't you cry
Cause I'll be waiting on the other side
You won't be alone
I'll make it feel like home

songs.title: Shiviti
songs.lyrics:
שִׁוִּיתִי יְיָ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד אַהֲבָה

(shiviti havayah l’negdi tamid)(2x)
((havayah)(5x) (ahavah)(5x))(2x)

I am ever mindful of God’s presence

songs.title: L'chi lach
songs.lyrics:
L'chi lach, to a land that I will show you
Lech l'cha, to a place you do not know
L'chi lach, on your journey I will bless you
And (you shall be a blessing)(3x) l'chi lach

L'chi lach, and I shall make your name great
Lech l'cha, and all shall praise your name
L'chi lach, to the place that I will show you
(L'simchat chayim)(3x) l'chi lach

songs.title: Sanctuary
songs.lyrics:
וְעָשׂוּ לִי מִקְדָּשׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָם׃
וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

v'asu li mikdash v'shochanti b'tocham
va'anachnu n'vareich yah mei'atah v'ad olam

Build for me a sanctuary so that I will dwell among them. And we shall praise God, now and forever.

Oh God, prepare me to be a sanctuary
Pure and holy, tried and true,
And with thanksgiving, I’ll be a living sanctuary for you.

songs.title: Ana el na
songs.lyrics:
אָנָא אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָהּ

ana el na refa na lah

I plead, God please heal her.

songs.title: Salaam
songs.lyrics:
עוֹד יָבוֹא שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כּוּלָם
سَلَام, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל הָעוֹלָם, سَلَام, سَلَام

((od yavo shalom aleinu)(3x) v'al kulam)(2x)

(salaam, aleinu v'al kol ha'olam, salaam salaam)(2x)

Peace will come upon us and upon everyone.

songs.title: Olam chesed yibaneh
songs.lyrics:
עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה

(olam chesed yibaneh)(4x)

The world is built by love

I will build this world from love
And you must build this world from love
And if we build this world from love
Then God will build this world from love

songs.title: We shall be known
songs.lyrics:
We shall be known by the company we keep
By the ones who circle round to tend these fires
We shall be known by the ones who sow and reap
The seeds of change, alive from deep within the earth
It is time now, it is time now that we thrive
It is time we lead ourselves into the well
It is time now, and what a time to be alive
(In this Great Turning we shall learn to lead in love)(2x)

songs.title: Loosen
songs.lyrics:
(Loosen, loosen, baby
You don't have to carry
The weight of the world
In your muscles and bones
Let go, let go, let go)(2x)

(Holy breath and holy name
Will you ease, will you ease this pain)(2x)

songs.title: Walking each other home
songs.lyrics:
Trust is the way that carries us home.
Trust is the way that carries us back home.
On the road of confusion no longer shall we roam, 'cause
(Trust is the way that brings us home.)(2x)

Love is the way that carries us home.
Love is the way that carries us back home.
On the road of fear no longer shall we roam, 'cause
(Love is the way that brings us home.)(2x)

Home, we are all on our way home
With different journeys, different lessons, different things to know.
No matter how long it takes or which way we choose to go
(Step by step we are walking each other home.)(2x)

Forgiveness is the way that carries us home.
Forgiveness is the way that carries us back home.
On the road of resentment no longer shall we roam, 'cause
(Forgiveness is the way that brings us home.)(2x)

Presence is the way that carries us home.
Presence is the way that carries us back home.
On the road of distraction no longer shall we roam, 'cause
(Presence is the way that brings us home.)(2x)

Home, we are all being guided home
With different stories, different rules, and different river flows.
It may seem like a far off dream and not one we've been shown
But (step by step we are walking each other home.)(2x)

Courage is the way that carries us home.
Courage is the way that carries us back home.
On the road of doubt no longer shall we roam, 'cause
(Courage is the way that brings us home.)(2x)

Home, we are all on our way home
With different journeys, different lessons, different things to know.
No matter how long it takes or which way we choose to go
(Step by step we are walking each other home.)(2x)

Home, we are all being guided home
With different stories, different rules, and different river flows.
It may seem like a far off dream and not one we've been shown
But (step by step we are walking each other home.)(2x)
No matter how long it takes or which way we choose to go
(Step by step we are walking each other home.)(2x)

songs.lyrics:

And I lay down my heavy load

And I lay down my heavy load
May the work I do speak for me

When I come to the end of the road
And I lay down my heavy load
May the words I speak speak for me

(May the path I walk speak for me)(2x)
When I come to the end of the road
And I lay down my heavy load
May the path I walk speak for me

(May the land I tend speak for me)(2x)
When I come to the end of the road
And I lay down my heavy load
May the land I tend speak for me

(May the seeds I sow speak for me)(2x)
When I come to the end of the road
And I lay down my heavy load
May the seeds I sow speak for me

(May the mountain we climb speak for me)(2x)
When I come to the end of the road
And I lay down my heavy load
May the mountain we climb speak for me

When I come to the end of the road

songs.title: Magnificence
songs.lyrics:
Part 1:

Wash me away so that all that's left is love, great spirit

Part 2:

Hallelujah, Hallelujah

Part 3:

Halelu, hallelujah,Halelu, hallelujah,

Part 4:

There is so much magnificence, in the ocean. Waves are coming in, waves are coming in

songs.title: Eden
songs.lyrics:
And then, and then, every person will be gentle
And then, and then, every person will be strong
Then all will be so varied, rich, and free
Then every where will be called Eden once again

songs.title: L’dor vador
songs.lyrics:
(l’dor vador vador)(2x)
l’dor vador, ancestors sing from the waters
l’dor vador, children shout from the trees
Generations to come demand that we act now
To heal the earth for all to thrive under the sun

l’dor vador, ancestors share their wisdom
l’dor vador, children take the lead
Generations to come demand that we act now
To heal the earth for all to thrive under the sun

L’dor vador, ancestors call for justice
L’dor vador, children chant for peace
Generations to come demand that we act now
To heal the earth for all to thrive under the sun

[niggun]

songs.title: Bashanah haba'ah
songs.lyrics:
בַּשָּׁנָה הַבָּאָה נֵשֵׁב עַל הַמִּרְפֶּסֶת
וְנִסְפּוֹר צִפּוֹרִים נוֹדְדוֹת.
יְלָדִים בְּחוּפְשָׁה יְשַׂחֲקוּ תּוֹפֶסֶת
בֵּין הַבַּיִת לְבֵין הַשָּׂדוֹת.

עוֹד תִּרְאֶה, עוֹד תִּרְאֶה
כַּמָּה טוֹב יִהְיֶה
בַּשָּׁנָה, בַּשָּׁנָה הַבָּאָה.

bashanah haba'ah neisheiv al hamirpeset
venispor tziporim nod'dot
y'ladim b'chufshah y'sachaku tofeset
bein habayit levein hasadot
(od tireh)(2x)
kammah tov yihyeh
(bashanah)(2x) haba'ah

Next year we will sit on the balcony
and count migrating birds.
Children on vacation will play tag
between the house and the fields.
You will see how good it will be next year.

Soon the day will arrive when we will be together
And no longer shall we live in fear
And the children will smile without wondering whether
on that day will dark clouds appear

(Wait and see)(2x) what a world this could be
if we share, if we care, you and me

עוֹד תִּרְאֶה, עוֹד תִּרְאֶה
כַּמָּה טוֹב יִהְיֶה
בַּשָּׁנָה, בַּשָּׁנָה הַבָּאָה.

(od tireh)(2x)
kammah tov yihyeh
(bashanah)(2x) haba'ah

You will see how good it will be next year.

songs.title: Prayer before Amidah
songs.lyrics:
אֲדֹנָתִי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּחִי, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתָיִךְ

(adonati s'fatai tiftachi ufi yagid t'hilatayich

Open up my lips oh God and I will sing your praise)(2x)

You bless us Elohei Sarah, You bless us Elohei Rivkah
You bless us Elohei Rachel, You bless us Elohei Leah
You bless us Elohei Avraham, You bless us Elohei Yitzchak
You bless us Elohei Ya'akov, You bless us Elohei Yisra'eil

songs.title: Siete modos de guisar la berenjena
songs.lyrics:
Siete modos de guisados
se guisa la merenjena.
La primera de las guisá es la vava de Elena
Ya la hace bokaditos
i la mete’n una sena
Esta komida la yaman komida de merenjena.

A mi tiyo, Serasi, que le agrada beber vino:
Kun el vino, vino, vino,
Mucho y bien a él vino.

La segunda que le guisa
es la mujer del Shamas,
La kavaca por ariento y la inchi d’aromat
Esta komida la yaman
la komida la dolmá.

La tracerá que la guisa
es mi prima Ester de Chiote.
La kavaca por arientro y la hinchi d’arroz moti.
Esta komida la yaman
la komida la alomondrote.

La alburniya es saborida
en kolor y en golor.
Ven haremos una sena mos gozaremos los dos
Antes que venga el guzano
y le kite la sabor.



En las mezas de la fiestas
syempre briya el jandrajo.
Ya l’hacemos pastelikos,
I las briyan en loz platos
Asperando a ser servidos
kun los güevos jaminados.

La salata maljasina es pastosa y saborida.
Mi vesina la prepara kun mucho aceite de oliva,
Estos platos acompañan
a los rostros de gallinas.

La setena que la guise
es mejor y mas janina.
La prepara Filisti, la hija de la vecina.
Ya la mete en el forno
de kabeza a la kocina kun aceite y pimienta
ya la yama una meyina.

There are seven different
ways to cook eggplant.
The first recipe is Elena’s specialty.
She cuts it into bite-sized pieces
and serves it for supper,
And this meal is called a dish of eggplant.

My Uncle, Cerasi, likes to drink wine,
Lots of it;
He feels fine.

The second one who makes it
is the sexton’s wife;
She hollows it out and fills it with herbs.
This meal is called
a dish of dolma.

The third one who makes it
is my cousin, Ester di Chiote.
She hollows it out and fills it with rice.
This meal is called
a dish of almondrote.

The alburnia is a tasty recipe
both for its color and aroma.
Come, let’s make a supper to enjoy together,
Before the worm comes
and takes the flavor away.

On the tables at the feasts
the jandrajo always shines.
We make little pastries out of it,
They shine in the plates
waiting to be served
with hard-boiled eggs.

The maljasina salad is rich and tasty.
My neighbor makes it with a lot olive oil.
It’s served with
left-over hen.

The seventh way it’s made
is the best and most exquisite.
Filisti, the neighbor’s daughter, makes it.
She puts it in the oven
in an open dish with oil and pepper,
And they call it a meyina.

songs.title: Las tiyas
songs.lyrics:
Tiya Mazalta muz va a yamar nochi di Hanuka
Tiya Grasya muz va a yamar nochi di Hanuka

Para sinder laz kandelikas kun toda la mishpaha
Laz hanukiyas di sirma blanka muz kali alimpyar.

Tiya Luna muz va a yamar nochi di Hagada
Tiya Safira muz va ayamar nochi di Hagada

Para kumer laz albondikas kun toda la mishpaha,
Kantaremus “Un Kavrikiko” dispuez di laz birahas.

Tiya Paloma mus va a yamar a kumer in la suka
Tiya Estreya mus va ayamar a kumer in la suka,

Kun frutas i flores di muchas kolores
Kun toda la mishpaha.

Aunt Mazalta will invite us the night of Hanuka;
Aunt Grasya will invite us the night of Hanuka;

To light the little candles with the whole family;
The menorahs of white silver must be cleaned.

Aunt Luna will invite us the night of Passover;
Aunt Safira will invite us the night of Passover;

To eat the matzoh balls with the whole family;
We will sing “Had Gadya” after the prayers.

Aunt Paloma will invite us to eat in the Sukkah;
Aunt Estrella will invite us to eat in the Sukkah;

With fruits and flowers of many colors
With the whole family.

songs.title: Boka del diyo
songs.lyrics:
Non ay santo komo Adonai,
I non ay piyadozo komo ben Amram,
I non ay guardrada komo muestra ley,
I no ay ken la malde komo Israel.

De boka del Diyo,
de boka del Diyo,
Seamoz bendichos todoz loz djudiyoz
Mipi el, mipi el, yevorah kol Israel.

Non ay fuerte komo Adonai,
I non ay bendicho komo ben Amram,
I non ay grande komo muestra ley,
I no ay ken la malde komo Israel.

Non ay ermozo komo Adonai,
I non ay viejo komo ben Amram,
I non ay limpya komo muestra ley,
I no ay ken la malde komo Israel.

Non ay bueno komo Adonai,
I non ay limpyo komo ben Amram,
I non ay derecho komo muestra ley,
I no ay ken la malde komo Israel.



None is holy as God,
And none is as pious as Amram;
Nothing is guarded like our law,
Nor is there anyone to read it as Israel.

From the mouth of God,
from the mouth of God
All the Jews should be blessed,
from the mouth of God

There is none as mighty as God.
Nor any as blessed as the son of Amram;
Nor is there anything greater than our law,
Nor is there anyone to read it as Israel.

There is none as beautiful as God,
Nor any sage such as the son of Amram;
Nor anything purer than our law,
Nor is there anyone to read it as Israel.

There is none as good as God,
Nor anyone purer than the son of Amram;
Nor anything more righteous than our law,
Nor is there anyone to read it as Israel.

songs.title: Eftach
songs.lyrics:
הִנֵּה אֵל יְשׁוּעָתִי אֶבְטַח וְלֹא אֶפְחָד
כִּי עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ יְיָ וַיְהִי לִי לִישׁוּעָה
וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם מַֽיִם בְּשָׂשׂוֹן מִמַּעַיְנֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה
לַייָ הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶֽךָ סֶּֽלָה
יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עִמָּֽנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב, סֶֽלָה
יְיָ צְבָאוֹת אַשְרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵֽחַ בָּךְ
יְיָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ
לַיְּהוּדִים הָיְתָה אוֹרָה וְשִׂמְחָה
וְשָׂשׂוֹן וִיקָר כֵּן תִּהְיֶה לָּֽנוּ
כּוֹס יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא

hinei el y'shu'ati evtach v'lo efchad
ki ozi v'zimrat yah adonai vay'hi li lishu'ah
ushavtem mayim b'sason mima'aynei hay'shu'ah
la'adonai hay'shu'ah al am'cha virchatecha selah
adonai tz'va'ot imanu misgav lanu elohei ya'akov selah
adonai tz'va'ot ashrei adam bote'ach bach
adonai hoshi'ah hamelech ya'aneinu v'yom kor'einu
lay'hudim haytah orah v'simchah v'sason vikar
(kein tihyeh lanu)(2x)
kos y'shu'ot esa uv'shem adonai ekra
[niggun]

Behold, the God who gives me triumph.
I am confident, unafraid; for Adonai is my strength and might, and has been my deliverance.
Joyfully shall you draw water from the fountains of triumph; deliverance is Adonai's.
Your blessing be upon Your people.
Adonai Tz'vaot is with us; the God of Jacob is our haven.
Adonai Tz'vaot, happy is the one who trusts in You.
O Adonai, grant victory!
May the Sovereign answer us when we call.
The Jews enjoyed light and gladness, happiness and honor. So may it be for us.
I raise the cup of deliverance and invoke the name of Adonai.

songs.title: Swimming to the other side
songs.lyrics:
CHORUS: We are living ‘neath the great big dipper
We are washed by the very same rain
We are swimming in this stream together
Some in power and some in pain
We can worship this ground we walk on
Cherishing the beings that we live beside
Loving spirits will live forever
We’re all swimming to the other side

I am alone and I am searching
Hungering for answers in my time
I am balanced at the brink of wisdom
I’m impatient to receive a sign
I move forward with my senses open
Imperfection, it be my crime
In humility I will listen
We’re all swimming to the other side

CHORUS

On this journey through thoughts and feelings
Binding intuition, my head, my heart
I am gathering the tools together
I’m preparing to do my part
All of those who have come before me
Band together and be my guide
Loving lessons that I will follow
We’re all swimming to the other side

CHORUS

When we get there, we’ll discover
All of the gifts we’ve been given to share
Have been with us since life’s beginning
And we never noticed they were there
We can balance at the brink of wisdom
Never recognizing that we’ve arrived
Loving spirits will live together
We’re all swimming to the other side

CHORUS

(Loving spirits will live forever
We’re all swimming to the other side)2x)
